chapters.title: Chapter 101: Celestial Hand and Silk Bind, New Skills!
paragraphs: Ding!
[The "Heavenly One" has granted you the "Celestial Hand" passive skill.]
"Oh?"
Leon’s eyes narrowed slightly as he stared at the panel floating in front of him. Then, slowly, a wide grin spread across his face.
"Interesting."
Just the fact that the word celestial was part of the skill’s name was already enough to make his expectations rise.
Skills tied to his identity as a [Celestial] had never disappointed him so far. Not once.
Without hesitation, Leon accepted it.
Ding!
[You have learned "Celestial Hand (Ancient)"]
"...What?"
Leon froze for half a second.
"Ancient-rank?!" His eyes widened. "Holy hell."
Ancient. That was the rank after Mythical.
In this life, Leon had already encountered many skill and item ranks, and he knew exactly how absurd this was. From the lowest to the highest he had seen so far, the hierarchy went:
Common, Uncommon, Rare, Elite, Epic, Legendary, Mythical and Ancient.
There were even higher ranks beyond that, but for most players, Legendary was already something they would rarely see in the [Lower Domain].
In his past life, it was only in the [Higher Domain] that the items or skills other players acquired became powerful.
In fact, ancient-rank items/skills were rare in there too. And now he had one of each.1
Meanwhile, Emilia blinked a few times before speaking.
"The name of my new skill is [Silk Bind (Legendary)]," she said, turning toward Leon. "It sounds... strong."
Leon looked at her, then nodded slowly.
"Legendary is still amazing," he said honestly.
Still, he couldn’t help but notice the difference in rank between the two rewards. Ancient for him. Legendary for her.
Why? He didn’t voice the thought.
The one who decided these things was the [Heavenly One], and trying to understand that being’s logic was probably pointless.
Emilia quickly sent her skill panel over to Leon so he could take a look.
[Silk Bind (Legendary Lv.1): Summon threads of silk to bind your enemies firmly, though they may break free.]
Leon’s eyes lit up as soon as he finished reading it.
"A restraint-type skill," he said, clearly impressed. "That’s amazing."
He immediately understood how valuable it was.
Emilia’s biggest weakness had never been her damage. It was her lack of reliable control.
Her attacks were devastating, but most of them covered wide areas, making them easier to avoid for opponents with high agility.
In fact, that was the only realistic way Leon himself could beat Emilia if they ever fought seriously.
If he could dodge her attacks long enough and keep pressuring her, she’d eventually fall.
Not that he planned to ever test that theory.
But now? With [Silk Bind], everything changed.
If an enemy was restrained, even for a moment, Emilia’s spells would land cleanly. And once that happened, the fight would end instantly.
"This is perfect," Leon said with a grin. "It even helps me indirectly."
Emilia smiled, clearly pleased. The [Affinity Skill Book] truly lived up to its reputation.
Leon was certain that if one ever appeared on the market, people would pay millions for it without hesitation.
Still, his attention quickly returned to his own skill. He turned his gaze back to his panel.
Ding!
[Celestial Hand (Ancient Lv.1): Upon killing an enemy, there is a 10% chance that this skill allows you to choose one of the items dropped by a monster and obtain an additional copy of it.]
At first glance, Leon’s expression remained neutral.
It didn’t sound flashy. There were no explosions, no divine attacks, no direct combat boost.
But then the meaning fully sank in. And Leon’s breathing slowed.
"This..." he muttered.
It wasn’t an active skill. It was a passive one.
A passive that directly interacted with drops.
Leon immediately understood why the [Heavenly One] had given him this skill.
It knew about his [100% Drop Rate] talent.
And instead of giving him more raw power, it gave him something far more terrifying in the long run.
"Incredible," Leon whispered.
He showed the panel to Emilia. She read it once. Then again.
"...Wait," she said slowly. "Does this mean... you can sometimes get two of the same item?"
"Probably," Leon nodded. "Only ten percent for now, but still..."
Emilia stared at him like he had just broken the rules of the world.
"That’s insane."
"It really is," Leon agreed. "The only thing I’m unsure about is how it works exactly."
"Only one way to find out," Emilia said, grinning.
Leon laughed. Without wasting any more time, the two of them left the quiet alley and returned to the main square of [Myriad Race City].
The place was still lively, filled with players talking excitedly about the recent fights in the [Myriad Arena].
But Leon and Emilia didn’t care. They had something better to do.
Soon after, they headed toward the city gates.
"We’ll come back later," Leon said as they exited. "For now, we focus on getting stronger."
He paused briefly.
"And on that egg."
Emilia didn’t ask what he meant. She already knew.
The [Primordial Dragon of Chaos]. Leon didn’t dare say its name out loud in public.
"Let me guess," Emilia said, "we’re going to some insanely secret and dangerous zone."
Leon chuckled.
"Of course. The [Star Magic Cave], a level 50 dungeon, in our case."
"...Damn."
The [Star Magic Cave] wasn’t a zone famous for loot or rare monsters. On the surface, it was simply a dangerous place where players could grind and grow stronger.
But Leon knew better. In his past life, after reaching the [Higher Domain], he had heard rumors.
If someone used a [Secret Realm Token] at the end of the cave at the hardest difficulty, a hidden realm would open.
Everyone who entered it disappeared. Most believed they had died.
And by the time Leon heard about it back then, returning to the [Lower Domain] was already impossible.
The orc guards at the gate glanced at Leon and Emilia with clear disdain but said nothing, allowing them to pass.
Just like that, they stepped into the wilderness of the second part of the [Lower Domain].

"We’ll need a [Secret Realm Token] first," Leon said as they walked. "Only then can we properly enter the [Star Magic Cave]. Its secret realm might hold something that helps with the egg or to make us stronger."
He didn’t count on it too much. But even a small chance was worth taking. If nothing else, it would be a good place to level up.
The [Higher Domain] was bound to have something that could help hatch the [Primordial Dragon of Chaos] anyway.
Unfortunately, [Secret Realm Tokens] were rare.
They didn’t drop from ordinary monsters. Not even most bosses.
You either obtained them from specific quests, very special enemies... or bought them.
Leon checked the [Trading House].
Beep!
[There are no "Secret Realm Tokens" available for sale.]
He sighed. Not that he could afford one anyway.
"Guess we hunt," Emilia said.
Leon nodded. They moved forward, deeper into the wilds.
A few minutes later—
Click! Krakks!
The ground around them cracked open.
Multiple figures burst from beneath the earth, surrounding Leon and Emilia from all sides.
[Earth Spider]
[Level: 31]
[Combat Power: 38,000]
[Details: A spider that acts in groups, usually lives underground and attacks anyone who disturbs its nest.]
Leon glanced around. Then he smiled faintly.
Emilia didn’t even blink. To them, this level of combat power was almost laughable.
"Time to test my new skill," Emilia said calmly, lifting her scepter.
SILK BIND!

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Using The New Skills, Double Drops?
paragraphs: SILK BIND!
The moment Emilia lifted her scepter, thin strands of shimmering silk burst forth, spreading outward in all directions.
They moved fast, far faster than Leon expected, and in the blink of an eye, they wrapped around every single [Earth Spider] surrounding them.
The monsters didn’t even have time to react.
Their legs were bound. Their bodies were locked in place. Some tried to struggle, others screeched, but it was useless.
The silk held them firmly, pinning them to the ground like helpless prey.
"Spiders restrained by silk," Emilia said with a grin, clearly amused. "Interesting."
Leon didn’t waste a second. He raised his staff, his expression calm and focused.
Storm of Lightning!
ZAP!
The air above the restrained spiders twisted violently as dark clouds formed in an instant. Crackling arcs of lightning danced within them, and then—
BOOM!
Bolts of lightning rained down mercilessly. The storm was overwhelming.
Charged by Leon’s SS-Level [Master of Elements] sub-talent, every strike carried terrifying destructive power.
The lightning annihilated. Each bolt pierced straight through the spiders’ bodies, burning, shattering, and erasing them completely.
There was no resistance. No screech lasted more than a fraction of a second.
In less than two breaths, every [Earth Spider] was dead.
Ding!
[You have killed x11 "Earth Spider" and gained 30,800 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
"Nice," Leon muttered.
As usual, once Leon and Emilia finished their second assessment, the familiar warmth of leveling up flowed through them again.
From this point onward, things would only get harder.
From level 25 all the way to level 50, every single level required 5,000 more experience points than the one before it.
For most players, that was where progress slowed to a crawl.
That was why, in Leon’s past life, the majority of time was spent in the [Higher Domain].
Leveling there was brutal. Even gaining a single level could take days, weeks, or even months depending on the person.
But right now? Leon felt nothing but confidence.
As long as he fought strong enemies, as long as he kept pushing into dangerous zones, experience points would pour in. The harder the challenge, the greater the reward.
Of course, Leon wasn’t stupid.
He knew there were monsters and beings so terrifying that even he couldn’t afford to be careless.
Some entities in the [Lower Domain] could wipe out entire groups if approached recklessly.
But for now, his goal was simple: get stronger.
He opened his [Storage Space] and checked the loot.
[Earth Spider Essence x11: Consuming will increase Constitution by 8 and Strength by 6.]
[Earth Spider Core x7 (Uncommon Material)]
"Pretty good," Leon said.
Nothing extraordinary, but essences were always valuable, especially at this stage. Without hesitation, he handed three of the essences to Emilia.
"You take these," he said. "Your constitution scaling makes better use of them."
Emilia nodded and accepted them without argument.
Leon was just about to close the panel and start consuming his own share when—
Ding!
["Celestial Hand" has activated on "Earth Spider"]
[Please choose one of the items dropped:]
[1. Earth Spider Essence.]
[2. Earth Spider Core.]
"Oh?" Leon’s grin widened. "Guess that 10% wasn’t lying."
He didn’t even hesitate and selected the [Earth Spider Essence] as it was simply better.
And the moment he selected it—
CELESTIAL HAND!
From Leon’s chest, a massive translucent hand emerged.
It was purple, vast, and unreal, its surface filled with swirling stars, like a fragment of space itself had taken shape.
The hand shot forward, passing straight through the corpse of one of the spiders as if it wasn’t even solid.
Then—
Fwoosh!
It retracted, returning to Leon’s body while holding an item.
Leon’s eyes flicked to his inventory. Another [Earth Spider Essence] had appeared.
"...Incredible," he muttered.
He stared at the item for a moment, his mind already racing.
"I wonder if this works on any item..." he said quietly, ’Because if it does...’
The implications were terrifying.
If [Celestial Hand] could duplicate rare drops, powerful materials, or even certain sub-talents... then this passive alone could help him tremendously.
Of course, the chance was low for now. Only 10%. And as an Ancient-rank skill, upgrading it wouldn’t be easy.
The first level alone required 20 Enhancement Stones. Still, Leon was already satisfied.
After confirming the skill worked as intended, he consumed all of the essences he had kept.
Ding!
[+72 Constitution, +54 Strength.]
"Nice."
The increase wasn’t overwhelming, but it was solid. He could feel the difference in his body immediately, his muscles denser, his endurance slightly higher.
But this was only the beginning.
Now that both he and Emilia had tested their new abilities, it was time for the next step: finding a [Secret Realm Token].
"Even I don’t know exactly where one is," Leon said as they started moving again. "But I have an idea."
Emilia glanced at him. "Where?"
"The [Elven Stronghold] might have one if I remember correctly," Leon replied. "And as the name suggests, it’s not somewhere other races are welcome."
As said before, strongholds were special structures created using [Stronghold Tokens]. Guilds and organizations used them as bases, granting massive advantages.
Most powerful players didn’t bother creating them in the [Lower Domain] or even the [Higher Domain]. They moved on too quickly.
Leon’s rapid growth wasn’t unique.
In his past life, many players from high-level or eternal-level worlds passed through the [Lower Domain] in mere days. The [Higher Domain] took weeks or months at most.
They all shared the same goal: reach the point where true growth began.
That was why Leon had reached this stage in just over a day.
As for some others, they simply prefered to stay in this domain for a while to prepare.
The [Shadow Assassin Guild] and the [Church of Light] were perfect examples. Both had strongholds in their respective lower domains.
And Leon hated both of them.
’I need to get rid of them,’ Leon thought.
He knew the future. He knew exactly what those organizations would become.
Both would align themselves with the gods. Both would slaughter far too many.
The leader of the [Shadow Assassin Guild] and the [Archbishop of Light].
After joining their gods, they would gain power so vast that even Leon, at his current pace, doubted he could fight them head-on.
’But I don’t know any way to travel between [Lower Domains],’ Leon thought grimly. ’I’ll have to find one.’
Still, those two were nothing compared to the countless beings Leon intended to eliminate in the [Higher Domain].
For now, he focused on the present. He and Emilia continued forward.
An hour passed. During that time, anything that dared approach them was erased.
[Earth Spiders], [Shadow Wolves] and [Dark Undead].
Some attacked in groups. Others ambushed from the shadows. None survived.
Eventually, the environment changed. The monsters grew stronger. Their levels hovered around 40.
Anyone watching Leon and Emilia would think they were insane.
Players at their level wandering into a zone like this? Suicide.
And yet—
"Here it is," Leon said, stopping and looking ahead. "One of the first strongholds people usually encounter."
Emilia followed his gaze. In the distance, a massive structure came into view.
It wasn’t just a building. It was a city.
Elegant towers rose high into the air, woven with glowing vines and radiant crystals. The entire place radiated a natural, ancient presence.
Ding!
[As a human, approaching the "Elven Stronghold" is extremely dangerous. Refrain from doing so.]
Leon stared at the warning. Then he laughed.
"Hah," he said, grinning. "Good one."

He and Emilia had killed many monsters after all, and as expected... they leveled up.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 26 + 27!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 300 points in all attributes and 300 free points to distribute.]1
Leon let out a satisfied breath.
"Nice."
The feeling of leveling up twice at once never really got old. Moments like this had always felt rewarding.
And this time, it wasn’t just levels.
In addition to the stat bonuses from leveling up, his attributes had climbed sharply thanks to the essences he had consumed along the way.
Every time [Celestial Hand] activated, Leon didn’t even hesitate. He always chose the essence.
Materials could be farmed later. Equipment could be replaced.
But permanent stats? Those were priceless.
Ding!
[+302 Strength, +271 Constitution, +326 Spirit, +174 Agility.]
Leon flexed his fingers slightly as the power settled into his body.
It wasn’t explosive or overwhelming, but it was steady, like each bone, each muscle, had been reinforced layer by layer.
He split the spoils without much thought, handing over roughly a third of the [Constitution] and [Spirit] essences to Emilia.
With her constitution and spirit multiplier, she gained even more value from them than he did.
Emilia accepted them with a bright smile, consuming them immediately.
"Whoa..." she muttered, blinking a few times. "That feels amazing."
"Get used to it," Leon said lightly. "It only goes up from here."
Aside from essences, they had also picked up various basic materials, bones, hides, cores, fragments, but none of it was particularly impressive.
’I mean, I guess Tolkien will be happy, but I’d have to go back to [Moon City] for that.’
Compared to what they were already carrying, it was borderline worthless.
Leon didn’t bother checking most of it in detail. His focus was elsewhere.
Because the closer they got to their destination, the heavier the atmosphere became.
And then, another panel appeared.
Ding!
[Human, unless it is a matter of utmost urgency, you are not allowed to proceed any further.]
[Any more will force us to send our strongest warrior.]
Leon didn’t even slow his pace.
His eyes flicked over the warning for less than a second before dismissing it entirely.
"What kind of panel did you get?" he asked casually, glancing at Emilia.
"Huh... let me check."
She paused, her eyes unfocusing for a moment, then with a small gesture, she shared the panel with him.
[Hello, fellow elf, welcome to the "Elven Stronghold"!]
Leon stared at it for a second.
"...Damn."
The difference in treatment couldn’t have been more obvious if it tried.
One warning him of death and retaliation. The other welcoming her in like a long-lost family member.
But Leon wasn’t surprised. Emilia was an elf. He was a human.
In the [Lower Domain], most races tolerated each other to some degree.
Conflict happened, but outright exclusion was rare. Elves were some of the exception.
They were one of the only race that openly barred all outsiders from their strongholds.
"I wonder why they’re all so arrogant," Emilia said lightly, her tone almost amused. "Most of them are weak anyway."
Leon chuckled softly.
"But still," she continued, her eyes narrowing slightly, "it’s a good thing you brought us here. The ones who betrayed me... they’re probably here."
Leon tilted his head.
"Didn’t that happen only like a day ago?" he asked. "Our growth speed should’ve far outpaced theirs by now."
"No," Emilia said, shaking her head firmly.
She explained what had happened after Leon cured her of the poison.
The moment her body stabilized, she had been forcibly teleported back to her original [Novice Village].
At first, she thought only a few hours had passed.
But once she escaped the cave and reached civilization, she realized the truth: nearly three weeks had gone by.
Leon’s eyes narrowed slightly.
"Oh... that makes sense," he muttered. "Time distortion isn’t uncommon in [Eternal Ascension]. Certain zones mess with it pretty badly."
Some areas accelerated time. Others slowed it.
In his past life, he had once spent what felt like a single night training, only to return and discover an entire month had passed outside.
It was dangerous, but also exploitable. And then, barely a minute later...
Ding!
[You were warned, human.]
BOOM!
The air exploded.
A massive volley of arrows erupted from the walls of the [Elven Stronghold], blotting out the sky as they screamed toward Leon like a storm of steel and wood.
There were hundreds of them. No, thousands.
Darkness Barrier!
Leon raised his staff, and a dense black barrier instantly enveloped him.
The arrows struck it in a deafening barrage, clangs, cracks, and splintering echoes overlapping into a single violent roar.
But not a single arrow passed through.
They bounced off harmlessly, falling to the ground like broken twigs.
Leon didn’t even flinch.
"I want to speak to your leader," he said calmly, his voice carrying forward. "I have a request."
He knew exactly what the elves possessed.
In his past life, the [Elven Stronghold] had held one of the earliest [Secret Realm Tokens] in the [Lower Domain].
At the time, Leon had been too weak, and too cautious, to even think about approaching.
This time was different. [Secret Realms] were dangerous and brutal.
And even finding one in the first place was hard, the [Star Magic Cave] being the only one in this [Lower Domain].
But their rewards were incomparable.
And before heading to the [Star Magic Cave], he needed that token. No matter what.
Leon had missed too many opportunities in his past life, not just because he lacked strength, but because he hesitated.
He had waited. Second-guessed.
And by the time he acted, it was always too late.
That wouldn’t happen again. It didn’t matter if these elves became enemies.
In the future, many of them would bow to the [Goddess of Nature] anyway, empowering her and contributing to countless disasters.
Leon had no illusions about alliances. Anyone who stood in his way was just another obstacle.
He needed power. And he was ready to fight for it.
A full minute passed. No response came from the walls.
Leon exhaled slowly.
"Well," he said, taking a step forward, "guess we’re doing this the hard way."
"I’m fine with that," Emilia said, a grin spreading across her face. "Let’s take the [Secret Realm Token].
Fighting an entire stronghold, even an underdeveloped one, was pure insanity by normal standards.
But Leon didn’t intend to remain "normal."
One day, he would need the strength to face entire cities... or kingdoms.
He lifted his staff, mana beginning to gather—
"Stop."
A powerful voice echoed across the plains.
The air itself seemed to vibrate as a figure appeared between Leon and the stronghold.
He was tall, nearly two meters, with long white hair and a matching beard. His ears were elongated, sharp, unmistakably elven.
The pressure rolling off him was immense. Enough to make weaker beings freeze on the spot.
Appraisal!
[ID: ElvenStronghold]
[Level: 50]
[Talent: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Combat Power: ??? (Above 150,000)]
Leon raised an eyebrow slightly.
The system rarely gave even this much information against powerful targets.
That was high. Extremely high for the [Lower Domain].
Even Leon would struggle if he fought carelessly. But he was certain of one thing.
’I’d still win.’
If necessary, [Celestial’s Might] could cripple the elf leader instantly. After that, either Leon or Emilia could finish the job.
Still... that would be a last resort.
Leon had no proof these elves had committed any unforgivable crimes yet.
Arrogance alone wasn’t enough to justify slaughter.
In his past life, he had known plenty of humans who acted the same way once they gained power.
’Everyone’s the same in the end,’ Leon thought with a faint grin.
"What do you want?" ElvenStronghold said coldly, disgust clear in his eyes. "Speak quickly. Any useless talk, and the full force of my stronghold will descend upon you."
Leon met his gaze without the slightest hint of fear.
"I want your [Secret Realm Token]," he said calmly. "In exchange... I can do something for you."
The elf’s eyes widened, "How do you even—"
He gazed at Emilia, and the moment he did, he stopped talking.
It wasn’t that [ElvenStronghold] was mesmerized by her beauty, but mostly that one of Emilia’s talent passives was currently working.
[Your reputation with all races is increased slightly more than anybody else, making them more eager to cooperate with you.]
This meant even someone like the elf leader was more eager to talk.
And so...
"We have no real use for it," ElvenStronghold said slowly. Then a sharp grin spread across his face. "But since you want it so badly... let’s make a deal."
And the moment he finished speaking—
Ding!
[You have received the S-Level Quest: "Bring a Stronghold Crystal to the Elven Stronghold."]
Leon clicked his tongue.
"Damn."

chapters.title: Chapter 104: S-Level Quest for Secret Realm Token, To The Land of Mist
paragraphs: Ding!
[You have received the S-Level Quest: "Bring a Stronghold Crystal to the Elven Stronghold."]
Leon didn’t hesitate even for a second. The moment the notification appeared, he opened the quest panel and began reading through every line with sharp focus.
[S-Level Quest: "Bring a Stronghold Crystal to the Elven Stronghold."]
[Time Limit: 3 Days.]
[Objective: Bring a "Stronghold Crystal" to the "Elven Stronghold."]
[Penalty for Failure: Reputation with the "Elven Stronghold" drops to zero.]
[Reward: Secret Realm Token and Legendary Treasure Chest.]
[Description: The "Elven Stronghold" has been seeking a "Stronghold Crystal" for months to no avail. Bring them one to allow their stronghold to evolve.]
Leon closed the panel slowly.
Three days. That was... extremely doable for Leon.
"We are facing more dangers by the day," ElvenStronghold said, his tone heavy. "Having this [Stronghold Crystal] would greatly benefit us."
Leon looked at the elf leader calmly. There was no hostility in his eyes, no respect either. Just neutrality.
"Alright," Leon said with a grin. "I accept."
[Stronghold Crystals] were among the most sought-after resources tied to territory control.
Any stronghold that wanted to grow needed them. Without a crystal, a stronghold was stuck at its current level forever.
The [Elven Stronghold] was only Level 1. Obtaining a single crystal would allow it to evolve to Level 2, increasing its defenses, facilities, and overall influence.
But that was also the problem. Stronghold Crystals were absurdly rare in the [Lower Domain].
That was why most players didn’t even bother creating strongholds here.
Even if they managed to establish one, leveling it up was another matter entirely.
Each evolution required crystals, and each crystal was harder to find than the last.
For most people, this quest would be nearly impossible. For Leon, he already had a plan and a way to clear it.
What surprised him more was the additional reward. A [Legendary Treasure Chest].
He had expected the [Secret Realm Token], that alone was worth more than enough, but the legendary chest was a bonus even he hadn’t anticipated.
’Maybe this elf isn’t completely unreasonable,’ Leon thought.
"Well," ElvenStronghold spoke again, a faint smirk appearing on his face, "I doubt you’ll succeed. But if you do... we might be thankful."
"Third time I’ve heard that," Leon replied with a relaxed grin. "I’ll be back in like an hour."
"Sure," the elf said dismissively.
Fwoosh!
In the next instant, ElvenStronghold vanished, his figure dissolving into particles of light as he returned to the safety of his stronghold.
Leon and Emilia were left alone on the plains.
"No reason to stay here anymore," Leon said as he turned around. "I got what I wanted."
"Nice," Emilia replied with a grin. "So we’re safe for now? At least nothing exploded."
Leon shook his head slightly, his expression turning serious.
"No," he said. "We’re far from safe now.
"...?" Emilia tilted her head.
"He used [Appraisal] on me," Leon explained. "Which means he probably saw my ID."
Emilia froze for a moment.
The implications were obvious. Leon’s ID wasn’t something that could be ignored, especially after the global announcement.
He knew that Leon was [Celestial] now.
The fact that ElvenStronghold showed no reaction meant only one thing: he noticed, and he chose not to say anything.
"That makes things... complicated," Emilia said quietly.
Leon nodded. "Exactly, though I wonder if he’ll do anything about it."
He sent the quest panel to Emilia so she could read it herself.
"Only three days?" Emilia’s eyes widened. "That’s brutal. The rewards are amazing, but it feels like he didn’t give you any room at all."
"We’ll be fine," Leon said confidently. "Unlike the [Secret Realm Token], I know exactly where to get a [Stronghold Crystal]."
"Really?" Emilia asked, surprised.
Leon nodded. "The [Land of Mist]."
Emilia’s expression shifted immediately. That name carried weight.
The [Land of Mist] sat at the boundary between the first and second sections of the [Lower Domain].
Anyone traveling between them, especially those returning to [Moon City], had to pass through it.
It was a Level 40 zone. And not a friendly one.
"Remember that monster I told you about?" Leon continued. "The one that could actually challenge you?"
Emilia’s eyes sparkled instead of showing fear. "So that’s it?"
"That’s the one."
She smiled widely. "Good. Let’s see if it can really live up to the reputation you gave it."
The two turned away from the [Elven Stronghold] and headed back in the direction of [Myriad Race City], their pace quick and deliberate.
Leon already had his next steps planned.
The [Star Magic Cave] wasn’t far from the [Elven Stronghold]. Once he obtained the [Secret Realm Token], he’d be able to enter it without delay.
’Everything is lining up,’ Leon thought as they moved. ’Almost too smoothly.’
The plan was clear: enter the [Land of Mist], kill the monster guarding the crystal, obtain the [Stronghold Crystal].
Return to the elves. Claim the [Secret Realm Token]. Head straight for the [Star Magic Cave].
And after that...
’The [Farlands],’ Leon thought. ’And finding a way to move between [Lower Domains].’
He still wanted to give Eleonore and the others some of the elemental sub-talents he had acquired, but he’d wait for them to reach the second part of the [Lower Domain] for that.
He didn’t have any equipment to give like before, but that didn’t worry him.
He believed in them. In his past life, they had grown stronger and faster than he did, even without his help. Their deaths had come from bad timing and worse luck.
With his intervention this time, their future would be completely different. They would rise.
Still, Leon wanted to finish everything he needed to do in the [Lower Domain] before ascending.
Leaving even one loose end could spiral into disaster later.
Fwoosh!
Soon enough, [Myriad Race City] came into view again. Leon didn’t slow down.
They passed by the city’s outer edges without entering and continued forward until the landscape changed.
Ahead of them stood a massive wall of dense, swirling mist. The [Land of Mist].
"There it is," Leon said with a grin. "Didn’t expect to come here this soon, but better to deal with it now."
He stepped forward.
Beep!
[You are about to enter the "Land of Mist."]
[It is not advised to enter unless fully prepared as the "Crystal Mist Guardian" resides within.]
"That’s exactly who I’m here for," Leon replied calmly.
Around them, several players who had been lingering near the entrance stopped and stared.
"They’re both level 27, are they insane?"
"I heard that most who enter while being below level 40 never come back, why would you even wanna go back anyway?"
"I mean, if you go back, you can farm on the newbies and get their loot!"
Some laughed. Others shook their heads.
A few spoke loudly, not bothering to hide their disbelief.
None of them intervened though. Why would they?
[Eternal Ascension] was massive, with billions of players. Two more deaths meant nothing in the grand scheme of things.
Still...
"Be careful, kid," a human man approached Leon, his expression serious. "If the [Crystal Mist Guardian] finds you, that’s a death sentence."
Leon looked at him, then nodded once.
"Thanks."
He didn’t bother explaining that being found was the entire point. Without another word, Leon stepped forward again.
The world around them shifted instantly. Visibility dropped to nearly nothing. The air grew heavy and cold.
Shapes moved at the edge of perception, only to vanish the moment they were noticed.
Ding!
[You have entered the "Land of Mist."]
[You have been inflicted with "Mist Summon."]
’Time to find that [Stronghold Crystal],’ Leon grinned as he gazed at the new panel that appeared before him.
I just wanna note that MC might seem carefree, but he will be absolutely ruthless to his enemies later, It’s just that it hasn’t been shown yet :).

The [Star Magic Cave] wasn’t far from the [Elven Stronghold].
Once he obtained the [Secret Realm Token], he’d be able to enter it without delay.
’Everything is lining up,’ Leon thought as they moved. ’Almost too smoothly.’
The plan was clear: enter the [Land of Mist], kill the monster guarding the crystal, obtain the [Stronghold Crystal].
Return to the elves.
Claim the [Secret Realm Token].
Head straight for the [Star Magic Cave].
And after that...
’The [Farlands],’ Leon thought. ’And finding a way to move between [Lower Domains].’
He still wanted to give Eleonore and the others some of the elemental sub-talents he had acquired, but he’d wait for them to reach the second part of the [Lower Domain] for that.
He didn’t have any equipment to give like before, but that didn’t worry him.
He believed in them.
In his past life, they had grown stronger and faster than he did, even without his help.
Their deaths had come from bad timing and worse luck.
With his intervention this time, their future would be completely different.
They would rise.
Still, Leon wanted to finish everything he needed to do in the [Lower Domain] before ascending.
Leaving even one loose end could spiral into disaster later.
Fwoosh!
Soon enough, [Myriad Race City] came into view again.
Leon didn’t slow down.
They passed by the city’s outer edges without entering and continued forward until the landscape changed.
Ahead of them stood a massive wall of dense, swirling mist.
The [Land of Mist].
"There it is," Leon said with a grin.
"Didn’t expect to come here this soon, but better to deal with it now."
He stepped forward.
Beep!
[You are about to enter the "Land of Mist."]
[It is not advised to enter unless fully prepared as the "Crystal Mist Guardian" resides within.]
"That’s exactly who I’m here for," Leon replied calmly.
Around them, several players who had been lingering near the entrance stopped and stared.
"They’re both level 27, are they insane?"
"I heard that most who enter while being below level 40 never come back, why would you even wanna go back anyway?"
"I mean, if you go back, you can farm on the newbies and get their loot!"
Some laughed.
Others shook their heads.
A few spoke loudly, not bothering to hide their disbelief.
None of them intervened though.
Why would they?
[Eternal Ascension] was massive, with billions of players.
Two more deaths meant nothing in the grand scheme of things.
Still...
"Be careful, kid," a human man approached Leon, his expression serious.
"If the [Crystal Mist Guardian] finds you, that’s a death sentence."
Leon looked at him, then nodded once.
"Thanks."
He didn’t bother explaining that being found was the entire point.
Without another word, Leon stepped forward again.
The world around them shifted instantly.
Visibility dropped to nearly nothing.
The air grew heavy and cold.
Shapes moved at the edge of perception, only to vanish the moment they were noticed.
Ding!
[You have entered the "Land of Mist."]
[You have been inflicted with "Mist Summon."]
’Time to find that [Stronghold Crystal],’ Leon grinned as he gazed at the new panel that appeared before him.
I just wanna note that MC might seem carefree, but he will be absolutely ruthless to his enemies later, It’s just that it hasn’t been shown yet :).

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Mist Summon, Waiting In The Land of Mist
paragraphs: [Mist Summon: 0%]
The moment Leon and Emilia stepped into the [Land of Mist], the same panel appeared before both of them.
It hovered quietly in their vision, simple yet ominous.
This was the core mechanic of the [Land of Mist], one that countless players cursed and feared.
The rule was straightforward, yet cruel.
The percentage would continuously increase at a fixed rate of 1% every fifteen seconds. Killing a monster reduced the value by 10%.
In other words, anyone inside the zone had to kill at least one monster every two and a half minutes just to maintain balance.
Fail to do so... And the consequences were absolute.
If the percentage ever reached 100%, the [Crystal Mist Guardian] would be summoned directly to the player’s location.
Once that happened, escape was impossible.
The area would be sealed, a domain formed, and the unlucky target would be forced into a direct confrontation.
Most died. Even players at level 50, the upper limit of the [Lower Domain], were routinely wiped out.
The guardian was simply too strong. But as always in [Eternal Ascension], danger came with reward.
Defeating the [Crystal Mist Guardian] granted a single, priceless item. The [Stronghold Crystal].
That alone was the reason this place still attracted challengers despite its terrifying reputation.
And so...
"So," Emilia said, glancing around the endless fog, her eyes shining with excitement, "are we heading somewhere specific?"
"No," Leon replied calmly, shaking his head. "This time... we just wait."
Emilia blinked and looked at him again, clearly confused.
Leon didn’t elaborate right away.
Normally, players entered the [Land of Mist] with a clear goal: hunt monsters nonstop, keep the [Mist Summon] value low, and avoid ever triggering the guardian.
Leon wanted the exact opposite. He had come here to fight the [Crystal Mist Guardian].
That was the fastest way to clear the S-Level quest, obtain the [Stronghold Crystal], and move on to the [Secret Realm].
There was no reason to waste time farming weaker monsters.
So instead of moving deeper into the mist... Leon and Emilia simply stood still.
The fog swirled lazily around them, thick and cold, muffling sound and sight alike.
After about a minute, Leon glanced at the panel again.
[Mist Summon: 4%]
"This is going to take a while," he muttered with a quiet sigh.
Since there was nothing to do but wait, Leon took the opportunity to relax slightly and review everything he had gained so far.
He opened his status panel, carefully reading through it as Emilia stood nearby, occasionally glancing around the mist.
"I hope nothing too strange shows up before the guardian," Emilia said lightly, smiling. "Though honestly, I’m pretty confident. Even the [Higher Domain] shouldn’t be that scary at this point."
Leon scratched his chin thoughtfully.
"Well..." he said slowly, "I wouldn’t go that far."
Emilia tilted her head. "Really?"
"There are some extremely powerful beings up there," Leon replied.
That was all he said. He didn’t mention the [Eternal Domain].
He didn’t talk about the gods, or the monsters that rivaled them, or the players who had survived long enough to stand at that level.
Because that place... That place was something else entirely.
Most players who reached level 100, the maximum of the [Higher Domain], never advanced further.
This included Eleonore, David and the others, as well as Leon for a good amount of time. They chose to stay behind.
Once someone entered the [Eternal Domain], there was no return.
And anyone who wasn’t fully prepared died almost instantly.
To put it simply, even a perfectly trained level 100 player could become nothing more than fodder there.
That was where gods walked freely. Where their servants roamed.
Where the strongest beings and most terrifying players in all of [Eternal Ascension] gathered.
It was a world that devoured the unworthy. That was why Leon needed more strength.
Far more than he currently possessed.
And it was also why he needed to erase every individual who would eventually align themselves with the gods.
Those people didn’t just gain overwhelming power.
They fed their gods with faith, devotion, and servitude, making them even stronger.
’Still...’ Leon sighed inwardly, ’I have time.’
There was no need to rush recklessly.
He opened his status panel, letting the familiar information fill his vision.
[Name: Leon Rykard]
[ID: Celestial]
[Talent: 100% Drop Rate (SSS)]
[Title: Celestial Being #200]

[Sub-Talents: Super Constitution Enhancement (B-Level), Super Strength Enhancement (C-Level), Embodiment of Darkness (A-Level), Super Agility Enhancement (C-Level), Super Spirit Enhancement (C-Level), Basic Necromancy (E-Level), Poison Resistance (C-Level), Blood Monarch (S-Level), Master of Elements (SS-Level)]
[Constitution: 3,673 (+6,080)]

[Skills: Appraisal (Common Lv.5), Vision Enhancement (Common Lv.4), Powerful Fireball (Common Lv.6), Storm of Lightning (Elite Lv.4), Crescent Slash (Epic Lv.2), Darkness Barrier (Epic Lv.2), Shadow Slash (Legendary Lv.2), Blood Beam (Legendary Lv.1), Celestial Hand (Ancient Lv.1)]
[Free Points to Allocate: 300.]
[Eternal Coins: 13,278]
[Reputation Points: 225]
A wide grin spread across Leon’s face as he took it all in.
Even knowing what he would eventually face, this growth was undeniable. Ridiculous, even.
At level 27, his combat power already surpassed what many level 40 or 50 players could achieve.
And this wasn’t even close to his peak. After closing the panel, Leon shifted his focus to his equipment.
Every piece he wore had been carefully chosen, upgraded, and enhanced.
Weapons:
[Undead Sword +3 (Uncommon): +1,100 Attack, +700 Strength, +200 Agility.]
[Void Staff +3 (Mythical): +2,500 Spirit.]
[Blood Heart Blessing: The "Spirit" bonus of the staff is tripled.]
Head:
[Wild Forest Crown +2 (Epic): All attributes +150.]
[Sage’s Chain +2 (Epic): +150 Spirit, -20% Cooldown Reduction.]
[Elemental Necklace (Mythical): Boosts the power of elemental attacks by 25%.]
[Toxic Snake Scales (Rare): +200 Constitution.]
Body:
[Elemental Dragon Armor (Mythical): +2,000 Defense, +1,200 Spirit, +1,000 Constitution, +500 Agility. Protects slightly from elemental attacks.]
[Blood Heart Blessing: Able to cast "Storm of Elements".]
[Silk Belt +2 (Epic): +350 Defense, +150 Constitution, +200 Agility.]
[Darkness Fur Boots +4 (Epic): +750 Agility, +400 Constitution.]
[Shadow Gloves (Epic): +500 Attack, +300 Strength, +150 Agility.]
Leon nodded to himself. Every piece was strong. Individually powerful. Together, terrifying.
’Still,’ he thought, ’My boots, gloves and necklaces could be better.’
Once he found higher-tier replacements, he would upgrade them without hesitation.
Finally, he checked the items bound directly to his soul.
[Blood Heart (Unique Special Item)] and [Primordial Dragon of Chaos (Unhatched)]
Just those two alone would drive countless players mad with envy.
All things considered, Leon was extremely satisfied. Now, all that remained was waiting.
[Mist Summon: 34%]
The fog grew thicker, the air heavier. Leon closed his eyes briefly, letting his thoughts wander.
[Mist Summon: 75%]
Emilia remained relaxed, though she could hear Leon murmuring faintly under his breath.
"Farlands... assassin guild... church of light... third assessment... danger... higher domains..."
The words were fragmented. Incomplete.
But the seriousness behind them was unmistakable. She didn’t interrupt him.
And then, after exactly twenty-five minutes.
Ding!
[Mist Summon: 100%]
The bar flared brilliantly, filling completely before flashing with a sharp silver light.
Fwish! Ding!
[The "Crystal Mist Guardian" has appeared. Pray for your lives.]
BOOM!
The mist around them exploded outward as the fog condensed violently, forming a sealed arena.
The ground trembled. The air screamed.
And from within the swirling mist... A massive silhouette emerged.
"More souls to add to my collection~" a voice echoed, distorted and amused. "Oh, I love these stupid players."
I felt like this was the best way to show Leon’s entire status panel :).
Do note it will not be shown often and instead will happen only once in a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: The Crystal Mist Guardian, The Land of Mist’s Zone Boss
paragraphs: [Crystal Mist Guardian (Zone Boss)]
[Level: 40]
[Exclusive Talent: Guardian of Mist (B-Level)]
[Combat Power: 122,000]
[Details: The guardian that resides in the "Land of Mist", slaying anyone who encounters it and taking their souls.]
The moment the panel finished loading, the figure before Leon and Emilia fully emerged from the swirling fog.
The [Crystal Mist Guardian] stood close to three meters tall, its entire body formed from dense, shifting mist that glimmered faintly like fractured crystal.
Its shape was humanoid, yet distorted, four long arms extended from its torso, two of them gripping massive spears formed from condensed fog and crystal shards.
The other two hands flexed slowly, as if grasping invisible prey.
Its presence alone weighed heavily on the air.
Pressure pressed down on Leon and Emilia’s shoulders, thick and suffocating, making it clear this was not a normal monster.
And yet, neither of them flinched.
Leon calmly raised his sword and staff, his stance steady and relaxed. Emilia stepped to the side, scepter in hand, her expression focused rather than afraid.
They had already decided the outcome.
’The moment [Celestial’s Might] activates, this will be much easier,’ Leon thought with a faint grin. ’Too bad for that thing.’
Without wasting another second, Leon burst forward.
The ground cracked beneath his feet as he accelerated, sword raised high.
Silk Bind!
At the same time, Emilia lifted her scepter and released threads of shining silk toward the guardian.
The silk shot forward in every direction, aiming to wrap around its arms, legs, and torso.
For a brief moment, it looked like it might work.
Then—
"Futile."
Fwoosh!
The guardian moved. With an almost casual motion, it swung both spears through the air.
The blades sliced cleanly through the silk threads, severing them before they could even tighten.
The silk dissolved into mist the moment it was cut.
"Oh."
Emilia’s eyes widened slightly.
At that instant, she understood the biggest flaw of her new skill.
[Silk Bind] was powerful, but the threads themselves were fragile.
Against enemies that lacked sharp attacks or precise control, it was devastating. Against an opponent that could cut or burn them... It lost most of its value.
Still, Leon didn’t slow down. He had never planned on relying on that skill anyway.
Slash!
Leon’s sword came down in a powerful arc, aimed directly at the guardian’s torso.
Clang!
The guardian raised one of its spears and blocked the strike effortlessly. The impact sent a shockwave through the mist, rippling outward.
Leon immediately jumped back. He already knew what was supposed to happen next.
And yet, nothing.
Leon frowned slightly. [Celestial’s Might] didn’t activate.
’The first condition is met,’ Leon thought quickly. ’That thing is stronger than me. And I clearly attacked it physically... so why?’
No divine pressure erupted to reduce the guardian’s combat power.
For a fraction of a second, doubt crossed his mind, but it vanished just as fast.
Even without it, he believed they could win.
"Come forth, my souls~"
The guardian’s voice echoed unnaturally through the fog as it raised one of its free hands.
Mist surged outward, twisting and compressing until shapes began to form. Humanoid shapes.
[Soul of Mist]
[Level: 40]
[Exclusive Talent: Mist Puppet (B-Level)]
[Combat Power: 80,000]
[Details: Players who die to the guardian are taken by him as his mist puppets, allowing him to use them.]
One by one, figures emerged, distorted silhouettes resembling armored players, their faces blank and hollow.
Leon’s expression darkened.
"Watch out," he warned Emilia as the guardian and its summoned souls advanced. "This thing is stronger than expected."
Even with a listed combat power of 122,000, its abilities, experience, and summoned minions made it far deadlier than the numbers suggested.
Leon thought fast.
"Get rid of the souls first," he ordered. "Then focus your spells on the guardian. A few clean hits should finish it."
Emilia took a sharp breath, steadying herself.
She nodded.
Strength Buff! Speed Buff!
Golden light wrapped around Leon’s body as Emilia enhanced him without hesitation.
Immediately after, she pointed her scepter forward.
DIVINE BEAM!
A golden ray charged for less than a second before exploding forward, cutting through the mist like a blade of light.
"I like it when they struggle~" the guardian laughed.
BOOM!
The beam tore through the summoned souls instantly.
One after another, the [Soul of Mist] figures disintegrated into nothingness, unable to withstand the divine energy.
The beam continued onward, striking the guardian itself and forcing it back slightly.
But unlike everything they had faced so far... It didn’t die.
"Tch."
The guardian raised its arms.
"Catch this~"
Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
Both spears were hurled through the air with terrifying speed.
Emilia twisted her body and barely avoided the first spear, the weapon passing close enough to tear strands of hair free.
But the second—
BAM!
It struck her shoulder directly. The impact sent Emilia flying backward several meters, her feet skidding across the ground as she struggled to regain balance.
She gasped and looked down. A small wound had formed where the spear hit. Blood seeped out slowly.
It wasn’t deep. But it was real.
’I’m so dumb,’ Emilia cursed inwardly. ’Leon warned me.’
Even with her high [Constitution], even with her titles and buffs, she wasn’t invincible.
She could still be hurt. And if she was careless enough... She could lose.
The confidence she had gained after becoming a [Magic Saint] had made her slightly arrogant.
That mistake would not happen again.
Slash!
Leon attacked once more, rushing the guardian head-on.
This time, the guardian extended its two free hands.
Mist Shield!
A translucent barrier of condensed mist formed instantly, blocking Leon’s strike and pushing him back.
Leon slid across the ground but remained upright.
And then—
"NOW!" Leon shouted.
He lifted his staff high. Emilia’s eyes flared with understanding as she raised her scepter again.
SPECTRAL FLAMES!
Ghostly flames erupted and rushed toward the guardian, but instead of attacking directly, they circled around it, forming a burning ring. A prison.
The moment the guardian tried to step forward, the flames hissed violently, reacting to its presence.
"Idiotic attempt," the guardian roared. "A few more attacks, and you will fall."
But Leon was already moving.
Powerful Fireball! Storm of Lightning! Blood Beam!
Leon unleashed everything at once.
Fire, lightning, and blood-colored energy surged forward simultaneously, shaking the air with their combined power.
For the first time, the guardian’s expression tightened.
But trapped within the [Spectral Flames], it had no room to dodge.
Mist Shield!
The barrier formed again just in time.
BAM! ZAP!
The spells collided with the shield, shattering it completely.
The explosion rocked the arena, leaving the guardian exposed.
"DIE!"
The guardian hurled both spears again, one toward Leon, the other toward Emilia.
Shadow Slash!
Leon vanished into the shadows, the spear passing harmlessly through empty space.
The guardian froze. And before it could react, Leon appeared behind it.
"We win."
SLASH!
Darkness surged along Leon’s blade as he struck. The attack pierced straight through the guardian’s defense, tearing through its misty form.
"ARGH—!"
The guardian screamed, trying to retaliate. But Emilia was already casting again as her cooldowns had reset.
DIVINE BEAM!
A final beam of golden light fired instantly, erasing the remaining spear mid-air and slamming directly into the guardian’s head.
The massive figure shuddered once. Then collapsed.
The mist dispersed, fading into nothing.
Ding!
[You have killed "Crystal Mist Guardian (Zone Boss)" and gained 140,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
Leon didn’t even need to look at his bar. He already knew.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 28 + Level 29 + Level 30!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 450 points in all attributes and 450 free points to distribute.]
"Perfect," Leon nodded, genuinely relieved.
They had done it. Even without [Celestial’s Might], they had won.
He would need to understand why it hadn’t activated, but that could wait.
Right now, there was something far more important: the [Stronghold Crystal].
Leon was about to open his [Storage Space] to check for it when—
Ding!
["Celestial Hand" has activated on "Crystal Mist Guardian"]
[Please choose one of the items dropped:]
[1. Crystal Mist Guardian Essence.]
[2. Stronghold Crystal.]
Leon’s eyes widened. He didn’t even glance at the other items even though there were more below.
"Incredible," he murmured as he selected the crystal without hesitation.
And then—
CELESTIAL HAND!

The blades sliced cleanly through the silk threads, severing them before they could even tighten.
The silk dissolved into mist the moment it was cut.
"Oh."
Emilia’s eyes widened slightly.
At that instant, she understood the biggest flaw of her new skill.
[Silk Bind] was powerful, but the threads themselves were fragile.
Against enemies that lacked sharp attacks or precise control, it was devastating.
Against an opponent that could cut or burn them...
It lost most of its value.
Still, Leon didn’t slow down.
He had never planned on relying on that skill anyway.
Slash!
Leon’s sword came down in a powerful arc, aimed directly at the guardian’s torso.
Clang!
The guardian raised one of its spears and blocked the strike effortlessly.
The impact sent a shockwave through the mist, rippling outward.
Leon immediately jumped back.
He already knew what was supposed to happen next.
And yet, nothing.
Leon frowned slightly.
[Celestial’s Might] didn’t activate.
’The first condition is met,’ Leon thought quickly. ’That thing is stronger than me.
And I clearly attacked it physically... so why?’
No divine pressure erupted to reduce the guardian’s combat power.
For a fraction of a second, doubt crossed his mind, but it vanished just as fast.
Even without it, he believed they could win.
"Come forth, my souls~"
The guardian’s voice echoed unnaturally through the fog as it raised one of its free hands.
Mist surged outward, twisting and compressing until shapes began to form.
Humanoid shapes.
[Soul of Mist]
[Level: 40]
[Exclusive Talent: Mist Puppet (B-Level)]
[Combat Power: 80,000]
[Details: Players who die to the guardian are taken by him as his mist puppets, allowing him to use them.]
One by one, figures emerged, distorted silhouettes resembling armored players, their faces blank and hollow.
Leon’s expression darkened.
"Watch out," he warned Emilia as the guardian and its summoned souls advanced.
"This thing is stronger than expected."
Even with a listed combat power of 122,000, its abilities, experience, and summoned minions made it far deadlier than the numbers suggested.
Leon thought fast.
"Get rid of the souls first," he ordered.
"Then focus your spells on the guardian.
A few clean hits should finish it."
Emilia took a sharp breath, steadying herself.
She nodded.
Strength Buff!
Speed Buff!
Golden light wrapped around Leon’s body as Emilia enhanced him without hesitation.
Immediately after, she pointed her scepter forward.
DIVINE BEAM!
A golden ray charged for less than a second before exploding forward, cutting through the mist like a blade of light.
"I like it when they struggle~" the guardian laughed.
BOOM!
The beam tore through the summoned souls instantly.
One after another, the [Soul of Mist] figures disintegrated into nothingness, unable to withstand the divine energy.
The beam continued onward, striking the guardian itself and forcing it back slightly.
But unlike everything they had faced so far...
It didn’t die.
"Tch."
The guardian raised its arms.
"Catch this~"
Fwoosh!
Fwoosh!
Both spears were hurled through the air with terrifying speed.
Emilia twisted her body and barely avoided the first spear, the weapon passing close enough to tear strands of hair free.
But the second—
BAM!
It struck her shoulder directly.
The impact sent Emilia flying backward several meters, her feet skidding across the ground as she struggled to regain balance.
She gasped and looked down.
A small wound had formed where the spear hit.
Blood seeped out slowly.
It wasn’t deep.
But it was real.
’I’m so dumb,’ Emilia cursed inwardly. ’Leon warned me.’
Even with her high [Constitution], even with her titles and buffs, she wasn’t invincible.
She could still be hurt.
And if she was careless enough...
She could lose.
The confidence she had gained after becoming a [Magic Saint] had made her slightly arrogant.
That mistake would not happen again.
Slash!
Leon attacked once more, rushing the guardian head-on.
This time, the guardian extended its two free hands.
Mist Shield!
A translucent barrier of condensed mist formed instantly, blocking Leon’s strike and pushing him back.
Leon slid across the ground but remained upright.
And then—
"NOW!" Leon shouted.
He lifted his staff high.
Emilia’s eyes flared with understanding as she raised her scepter again.
SPECTRAL FLAMES!
Ghostly flames erupted and rushed toward the guardian, but instead of attacking directly, they circled around it, forming a burning ring.
A prison.
The moment the guardian tried to step forward, the flames hissed violently, reacting to its presence.
"Idiotic attempt," the guardian roared.
"A few more attacks, and you will fall."
But Leon was already moving.
Powerful Fireball!
Storm of Lightning!
Blood Beam!
Leon unleashed everything at once.
Fire, lightning, and blood-colored energy surged forward simultaneously, shaking the air with their combined power.
For the first time, the guardian’s expression tightened.
But trapped within the [Spectral Flames], it had no room to dodge.
Mist Shield!
The barrier formed again just in time.
BAM!
ZAP!
The spells collided with the shield, shattering it completely.
The explosion rocked the arena, leaving the guardian exposed.
"DIE!"
The guardian hurled both spears again, one toward Leon, the other toward Emilia.
Shadow Slash!
Leon vanished into the shadows, the spear passing harmlessly through empty space.
The guardian froze.
And before it could react, Leon appeared behind it.
"We win."
SLASH!
Darkness surged along Leon’s blade as he struck.
The attack pierced straight through the guardian’s defense, tearing through its misty form.
"ARGH—!"
The guardian screamed, trying to retaliate.
But Emilia was already casting again as her cooldowns had reset.
DIVINE BEAM!
A final beam of golden light fired instantly, erasing the remaining spear mid-air and slamming directly into the guardian’s head.
The massive figure shuddered once.
Then collapsed.
The mist dispersed, fading into nothing.
Ding!
[You have killed "Crystal Mist Guardian (Zone Boss)" and gained 140,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
Leon didn’t even need to look at his bar.
He already knew.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 28 + Level 29 + Level 30!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 450 points in all attributes and 450 free points to distribute.]
"Perfect," Leon nodded, genuinely relieved.
They had done it.
Even without [Celestial’s Might], they had won.
He would need to understand why it hadn’t activated, but that could wait.
Right now, there was something far more important: the [Stronghold Crystal].
Leon was about to open his [Storage Space] to check for it when—
Ding!
["Celestial Hand" has activated on "Crystal Mist Guardian"]
[Please choose one of the items dropped:]
Crystal Mist Guardian Essence.]
Stronghold Crystal.]
Leon’s eyes widened.
He didn’t even glance at the other items even though there were more below.
"Incredible," he murmured as he selected the crystal without hesitation.
And then—
CELESTIAL HAND!

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Two Stronghold Crystals, Completing the Elf Leader’s Quest!
paragraphs: Celestial Hand!
For the second time today, the enormous celestial hand burst out from Leon’s chest, its glow sharp and overwhelming as it surged forward.
It pierced straight through the massive corpse of the [Crystal Mist Guardian] without meeting any resistance, as if the dead body didn’t even exist.
A split second later, the hand clenched around something invisible to the naked eye and pulled back.
The moment it returned, the glow faded, and everything it had taken was neatly deposited into Leon’s [Storage Space].
Leon let out a low breath he hadn’t realized he was holding.
Then he grinned. He opened his panel and stared at the loot.
[Crystal Mist Guardian Essence: Consuming will increase Spirit by 25.]
[Stronghold Crystal x2 (Mythical): Can be used on a stronghold to level it up and make it stronger. Do note you’ll have to face a beast tide after use.]
[Mist Spear x2 (Legendary): +2,000 Attack, +1,000 Strength, +500 Agility. Requirement: Level 40.]
[Mist Repellant Potion x3 (Epic): Consuming will allow you to look through the mist for an hour.]
"...Damn."
That was the only word Leon managed to say (like always). The drop was insane.
Even for a boss as dangerous as the [Crystal Mist Guardian], this was far above average.
The essence alone was valuable, not to mention the equipment and potions. Any high-level player would have gone crazy over a haul like this.
But Leon barely glanced at most of it. His eyes were locked on one thing.
[Stronghold Crystal x2.]
Two of them, not just one. A slow, satisfied smile spread across his face.
He had originally planned to secure a [Stronghold Crystal] for himself. It was something he’d need sooner or later, especially with his long-term plans.
But once he received the quest from the [Elven Stronghold], he had already made peace with the idea of giving that crystal away.
After all, the [Secret Realm Token] alone was more than worth it.
And yet...
Thanks to [Celestial Hand], he didn’t have to give up anything at all.
The second crystal was pure profit. A bonus.
Leon felt genuinely blessed by the timing of his skill activation. If it hadn’t triggered, he would’ve walked out with just one crystal. Instead, he now had options.
Unfortunately, when he checked his other panels, his mood dipped slightly.
It seemed like even with that, his [Blood Heart] hadn’t recharged.
"Tch."
Leon clicked his tongue.
’Guess it’s not that easy,’ he thought.
Still, it wasn’t a big deal. Judging from the pattern so far, it would come off cooldown soon. He just needed to kill a few more monsters.
Without hesitating, Leon consumed the [Crystal Mist Guardian Essence].
A warm, sharp sensation spread through his body as his Spirit stat increased. His mind felt clearer, his mana flow smoother, and his control over magic subtly improved.
He nodded to himself, satisfied. Then he looked back at the remaining items.
The potions were useful, but situational. He stored them away without much thought.
The [Mist Spear], however, made him pause. He took one out and inspected it carefully.
The weapon was long and slender, its surface covered in faint mist-like patterns that constantly shifted.
It radiated power, far more than his current weapon.
Stat-wise, it was undeniably superior to his [Undead Sword +3].
And yet... Leon frowned slightly.
’I still don’t feel like using a spear.’
He was already holding a staff in his other hand. Fighting effectively with a spear using only one hand was awkward at best and inefficient at worst. It wasn’t his style.
Even so, the spear was far too good to just ignore.
’Someone else will want this,’ Leon thought.
Then, an idea crossed his mind. He took out the second [Mist Spear].
"...Let’s try it."
He selected both spears and activated the fusion option.
Ding!
[You have consumed two identical equipment... enhancement successful!]
Leon blinked.
"Oh. It worked."
The two spears vanished, and a new weapon appeared in his panel.
[Mist Spear +2 (Legendary): +3,000 Attack, +1,700 Strength, +1,000 Agility. Allows user to cast "Spear Throw".]
Leon raised an eyebrow.
"Damn," he muttered, then nodded. "It even gained a skill."
[Spear Throw] wasn’t something he planned to use personally, but it made the weapon even more valuable.
"Good enough."
He stored it away. After finishing his checks, Leon turned toward Emilia.
She was still looking at her own panel, her expression bright.
"I dropped the boss’ essence and a potion," she said cheerfully as she consumed it on the spot.
"Good enough," Leon replied with a nod. "It’s time to go back."
"Damn, already?" Emilia laughed. "Guess you weren’t lying when you said you’d be done in an hour."
"Of course," Leon said calmly.
As they began heading toward the exit of the [Land of Mist], Leon opened another panel.
[Free Points to Allocate: 750.]
"...Damn."
That number alone would’ve made most players freeze in place. But Leon didn’t hesitate.
"400 in Spirit. 200 in Strength. 150 in Agility."
The points vanished instantly.
A powerful surge rushed through his body. His muscles tightened, his movements felt lighter, and the mana flowing through him became denser and more responsive.
Leon clenched his fist. He could feel it. He was stronger.
A grin spread across his face.
Ding!
[You have acquired the "Stronghold Crystal". Return it to "ElvenStronghold" to complete the quest.]
Leon closed the panel and turned around.
Fwoosh!
In less than a minute, Leon and Emilia emerged from the misty wall.
The players who had been waiting outside stared at them in disbelief.
"I guess they got scared shitless," someone scoffed.
"No wonder," another replied. "Still, I’m surprised they lasted thirty minutes. The guardian shows up around that time."
Even the human man who had warned Leon earlier stepped forward, concern clear on his face.
"Kid," he said, "did you encounter the guardian?"
Leon smiled.
"Yeah," he replied casually. "It’s dead."
"...What?"
Before the man could react further, Leon had already dashed forward, Emilia following closely behind.
"Don’t die," Leon called out without looking back.
They left behind a group of stunned players who could only stare in silence.
Leon didn’t slow down. He passed [Myriad Race City] once more and headed straight for the [Elven Stronghold].
When they arrived, Leon stopped and raised his voice.
"Come out."
The air warped. Within thirty seconds, the elf leader appeared before them.
"Did you give up already?" ElvenStronghold asked coldly. "What a waste of time."
It was clear he hadn’t believed Leon could complete the quest.
Leon didn’t argue. Instead, he opened his [Storage Space].
Fwoosh!
A brilliant blue crystal appeared in his hand.
"...Huh?" ElvenStronghold’s eyes widened, "Wait, what?"
"It took me over an hour because of travel time," Leon said with a smile. "But I think I was fast enough."
The elf stared at the crystal for a long moment. Then he sighed.
"No wonder you are [Celestial]," he muttered. "Do not worry. I won’t speak of this to anyone. Your help is appreciated."
His tone had softened just slightly.
"As agreed," ElvenStronghold said, tossing a small item toward Leon and dropping a chest on the ground. "Goodbye, human."
And just like that, he vanished.
Ding!
[Your reputation with elfs has slightly improved.]
Leon nodded. It wasn’t much, but it mattered. Then he looked at the token in his hand.
[Secret Realm Token (Mythical): Can be used in a place where a secret realm resides to open it. Do note that it is extremely dangerous.]
"Good."
