chapters.title: Chapter 115: Strength Restrictive, Unaffected Passive
paragraphs: Leon understood one simple truth the moment the battle began.
None of the spells he could cast would matter if the [Trace of God of Magic] simply blocked every single one of them.
It did not matter how powerful they were.
If the trace could defend against them without effort, then standing at a distance and trading spells would only lead to one result: he would be overwhelmed.
The trace possessed 250,000 Combat Power, the highest he had ever seen in the [Lower Domain].
And if Leon allowed the battle to turn into a pure magic exchange from the start, he would be crushed under sheer force.
So there was only one path available to him: he had to attack physically.
Not because it was easier. But because it would activate [Celestial’s Might].
The moment his blade attacked the enemy, the passive effect would trigger and reduce the trace’s attributes by thirty percent.
That reduction would bring the battle into a range where victory was possible.
Without that effect, he would not stand a chance.
Fwoosh!
Leon did not hesitate.
The instant the trace finished speaking, Leon kicked off the ground and dashed forward at full speed.
His body blurred as he closed the distance between them, sword already drawn and coated in energy.
The semi transparent figure watched him approach and smiled.
"Oh?" the trace said with amusement. "Another barbaric individual, I see. Do you not own a staff?"
Its tone was mocking, almost disappointed.
And then, with a lazy motion, it gently swayed its staff.
Strength Restriction!
The words were not shouted. Yet the effect was immediate. The entire [Secret Realm] shifted.
An oppressive aura flooded the chamber, pressing down from every direction.
It was not the kind of pressure meant to terrify or intimidate.
It was simply meant... to restrain, and not in the same way [Silk Bind] does.
As Leon rushed forward, translucent panels appeared before his eyes.
Ding!
[The "Trace of God of Magic" has hit you with "Strength Restriction"]
Leon’s eyes widened for a split second. And then it happened.
SLASH!
He felt nothing physically, yet something inside him was cut away.
He glanced at his status.
The numbers flickered. And then they vanished.
[Strength: 0]
His entire strength attribute had been erased as if it never existed.
"This is a domain of pure magic," the trace said, its grin widening. "Let us have a magic battle."
It pointed its staff forward, mana gathering at its tip in swirling currents of light. The density alone was enough to make the air tremble.
Leon clenched his teeth. Gods are able to cut attributes?
The realization sent a chill down his spine. This was not a debuff that reduced his power slightly.
’Or maybe it’s only because we are in this [Secret Realm].’
In an instant, Leon understood why no one had ever cleared this [Secret Realm].
Facing an enemy with 250,000 Combat Power was already insane.
But that same enemy could simply declare that physical strength did not exist within its domain.
Anyone who relied on swords, spears, or fists would die without being able to fight back.
It was unfair. Completely unfair.
Scarlet Explosions!
The trace raised its staff high.
From the stone floor beneath Leon, a massive crimson flower burst into existence.
Its petals unfolded slowly, glowing with violent energy.
The center of the flower rotated, then turned toward Leon like the barrel of a cannon.
From it, sharp sprouts shot forward.
Leon did not stop. He continued rushing toward the trace despite having zero strength.
BOOM!
The sprouts struck the ground behind him and detonated.
The explosion tore apart the stone tiles, sending debris flying in every direction.
Heat licked at his back.
’If I get hit even once, I will probably die.’
That thought was clear and cold. He needed to close the distance.
He needed to activate [Celestial’s Might].
Even if his strength was zero, the effect might still trigger.
But just as it seemed all hope was lost, another panel appeared.
Ding!
[A "Celestial" cannot be affected by such things.]
Leon blinked.
[You have learned the passive "Unaffected" linked to your "Celestial" title.]
"Huh?"
[Unaffected: No matter what happens, you cannot be affected by status effects or rules that change the way you usually fight.]
[Basically, you cannot be affected by: Stun, Paralyze, Restrain and more.]
For a brief moment, Leon simply stared at the words.
It was similar to [Unshaken], but far more absolute.
SLASH!
He checked his status again.
His strength returned in full as if nothing had ever happened.
A slow grin spread across his face.
’So even the rules of this realm cannot touch me anymore.’
Shadow Slash!
Without hesitation, Leon activated his ability.
His body dissolved into darkness and slipped through the shadows, avoiding the next wave of explosions entirely.
The trace tilted its head slightly.
"Why are you not using your magic yet?" it asked, almost teasing. "I know you have spells."
Leon did not answer.
He did not know whether this trace truly carried the personality of the real [God of Magic], or if it was merely a programmed fragment.
But if it did reflect the god’s character, then this information was valuable.
Arrogant, calm and amused even in battle.
While the trace continued speaking, Leon moved silently through the darkness.
"You talk too much," Leon said.
He emerged from the shadows directly behind the trace.
The semi transparent figure turned its head slowly, as if it had known his position all along.
"Are you stupid?" it asked. "You can’t use strength here—"
SLASH!
Leon’s blade, coated in shadow energy, cut through the trace’s torso.
A massive wound tore across its body. And its form flickered violently.
"Argh!" the trace cried out, staggering and dropping to one knee. "Huh...?"
It looked up at Leon. And as it saw his eyes, understanding dawned instantly.
"Celestial?"
Leon’s expression hardened.
’So the [God of Magic] can recognize what I am.’
"The only beings who can negate my status effects are the [Celestials]," the trace continued, rising slowly. "So you must be one of them."
It lifted its staff again.
"No matter."
Mana surged violently around it. This time the density was far greater.
It was no longer amused. It intended to kill him quickly.
"If you know I am a [Celestial]," Leon said calmly, "then how do you not know what comes next?"
"What comes—?"
Celestial’s Might!
An overwhelming pressure erupted from Leon’s body before the trace could even finish its sentence.
The force slammed into the trace like an invisible wave. Its attributes were instantly reduced by thirty percent.
[Trace of God of Magic (Realm Boss)]
[Combat Power: 175,000]
Leon’s eyes narrowed.
Even with the reduction, 175,000 was still monstrous. But it was manageable.
More importantly, the trace’s expression changed.
It clearly knew about the [Celestial] title and even about the passive that negated status effects.
Yet it did not seem to anticipate [Celestial’s Might].
Did that mean this ability was unique to him? Or simply unknown to this fragment?
It did not matter. He would end this now.
Before the trace could complete its next spell, Leon began his assault.
Powerful Fireball!
A blazing sphere of condensed flame shot forward.
Storm of Lightning!
Bolts descended from above, crackling with violent energy.
Blood Beam!
A crimson ray pierced through the air.
Ice Spikes!
Sharp pillars erupted from the ground.
Crescent Slash!
A crescent slash from his sword followed immediately after, rushing toward the enemy.
The trace’s eyes widened slightly. It reacted at once.
Barrier!
The stone floor of the chamber rose upward, forming a thick wall between them.
Layers of rock stacked together, reinforced by magical energy.
Under normal circumstances, that barrier would have been nearly indestructible.
But now its attributes were reduced.
BOOM!
Leon’s spells struck the barrier one after another.
And he continued casting, chaining spells without pause.
The barrier trembled violently.
"Just what are you?" the trace roared from behind the crumbling wall. "A normal celestial cannot do this!"1
SLASH!
Leon stepped forward and infused his blade with shadow as he swung with full force.
The barrier shattered completely. Fragments of rock exploded outward.
Before the trace could react, Leon continued his assault.
More spells. More strikes. No hesitation.
For nearly a full minute, the chamber was filled with constant explosions and flashes of light.
Finally, the trace fell to its knees for the second time.
Its semi transparent body flickered erratically.
Large portions of its form were unstable, breaking apart into particles of mana before reforming weakly.
It looked up at Leon with a dark expression.
"Just so you know, Celestial," it said slowly, "The [God of Magic] is aware of this encounter. The next time we meet will not be like this. It will be your end."
Leon stared at it calmly.
"And if you believe that the [Celestials] will be on your side... just let me tell you there are some far more terrifying ones..."
"Sure."
SLASH!
With one clean motion, he decapitated the trace.
Its head separated from its body, both dissolving into countless fragments of light that scattered and faded into nothingness.
Silence filled the chamber. Then the familiar sound echoed in his ears.
Ding!
[You have killed "Trace of God of Magic" and gained 360,000 experience points.
Leon exhaled slowly. It was done.
And...
Ding!
[Congratulations, you are now worthy of taking the "Forbidden Spell Book".]

SLASH!
Leon’s blade, coated in shadow energy, cut through the trace’s torso.
A massive wound tore across its body.
And its form flickered violently.
"Argh!" the trace cried out, staggering and dropping to one knee.
It looked up at Leon.
And as it saw his eyes, understanding dawned instantly.
"Celestial?"
Leon’s expression hardened.
’So the [God of Magic] can recognize what I am.’
"The only beings who can negate my status effects are the [Celestials]," the trace continued, rising slowly.
"So you must be one of them."
It lifted its staff again.
"No matter."
Mana surged violently around it.
This time the density was far greater.
It was no longer amused.
It intended to kill him quickly.
"If you know I am a [Celestial]," Leon said calmly, "then how do you not know what comes next?"
"What comes—?"
Celestial’s Might!
An overwhelming pressure erupted from Leon’s body before the trace could even finish its sentence.
The force slammed into the trace like an invisible wave.
Its attributes were instantly reduced by thirty percent.
[Trace of God of Magic (Realm Boss)]
[Combat Power: 175,000]
Leon’s eyes narrowed.
Even with the reduction, 175,000 was still monstrous.
But it was manageable.
More importantly, the trace’s expression changed.
It clearly knew about the [Celestial] title and even about the passive that negated status effects.
Yet it did not seem to anticipate [Celestial’s Might].
Did that mean this ability was unique to him?
Or simply unknown to this fragment?
It did not matter.
He would end this now.
Before the trace could complete its next spell, Leon began his assault.
Powerful Fireball!
A blazing sphere of condensed flame shot forward.
Storm of Lightning!
Bolts descended from above, crackling with violent energy.
Blood Beam!
A crimson ray pierced through the air.
Ice Spikes!
Sharp pillars erupted from the ground.
Crescent Slash!
A crescent slash from his sword followed immediately after, rushing toward the enemy.
The trace’s eyes widened slightly.
It reacted at once.
Barrier!
The stone floor of the chamber rose upward, forming a thick wall between them.
Layers of rock stacked together, reinforced by magical energy.
Under normal circumstances, that barrier would have been nearly indestructible.
But now its attributes were reduced.
BOOM!
Leon’s spells struck the barrier one after another.
And he continued casting, chaining spells without pause.
The barrier trembled violently.
"Just what are you?" the trace roared from behind the crumbling wall.
"A normal celestial cannot do this!"1
SLASH!
Leon stepped forward and infused his blade with shadow as he swung with full force.
The barrier shattered completely.
Fragments of rock exploded outward.
Before the trace could react, Leon continued his assault.
More spells.
More strikes.
No hesitation.
For nearly a full minute, the chamber was filled with constant explosions and flashes of light.
Finally, the trace fell to its knees for the second time.
Its semi transparent body flickered erratically.
Large portions of its form were unstable, breaking apart into particles of mana before reforming weakly.
It looked up at Leon with a dark expression.
"Just so you know, Celestial," it said slowly, "The [God of Magic] is aware of this encounter.
The next time we meet will not be like this.
It will be your end."
Leon stared at it calmly.
"And if you believe that the [Celestials] will be on your side... just let me tell you there are some far more terrifying ones..."
"Sure."
SLASH!
With one clean motion, he decapitated the trace.
Its head separated from its body, both dissolving into countless fragments of light that scattered and faded into nothingness.
Silence filled the chamber.
Then the familiar sound echoed in his ears.
Ding!
[You have killed "Trace of God of Magic" and gained 360,000 experience points.
Leon exhaled slowly.
It was done.
And...
Ding!
[Congratulations, you are now worthy of taking the "Forbidden Spell Book".]

chapters.title: Chapter 116 116: 250 Reputation Points, Reputable Title and Increased Stats
paragraphs: Ding!
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 37 + Level 38 + Level 39 + Level 40!]
[Due to "Heaven's Blessing", you have gained 600 points in all attributes and 600 free points to distribute.]
"Nice."
Leon let out a satisfied breath as the familiar surge of strength flowed through his body.
The experience from defeating the [Trace of God of Magic] had been enormous, far beyond what ordinary monsters could provide.
With that, he was now only ten levels away from reaching Level 50.
Level 50 meant the [Third Assessment].
And the [Third Assessment] was the final gate before entering the [Higher Domain].
He glanced around the silent chamber.
The semi transparent figure of the [Trace of God of Magic] had completely disappeared.
And more importantly, it left no drops.
It seemed like the trace did not drop any items as Leon's talent didn't activate.
He did not look disappointed though.
The real reward of this [Secret Realm] wasn't just random items after all.
It was something much greater.
Leon lifted his gaze toward the end of the chamber.
The [Forbidden Spell Book] sat quietly on the pedestal once more.
Now that he had completed the challenge of the [Secret Realm], the reward was finally available to him.
The air around the book shimmered faintly.
Before he moved toward it though, several panels appeared in front of him at the same time.
Ding!
[Your "Blood Heart" has recharged.]
"Nice," Leon nodded.
He had expected this.
After fighting the [Crystal Mist Guardian], the [Undead Scourge], and the [God of Magic's Disciple], he had expected it to recharge.
It had taken slightly longer than he initially predicted, but that was fine.
Now it was ready again. And then, another panel appeared.
Ding!
[Player "Celestial" is the first to complete the "Trace of Magic Chamber" secret realm and has been rewarded with 50 Reputation Points.]
The announcement echoed across the entire [Lower Domain].
Every player heard it clearly. In [Lower Domain #1], the reactions were immediate.
"God damn it, this Celestial guy again?"
"He is everywhere."
"I swear he does not let anyone breathe."
The players in [Lower Domain #1] were starting to get used to these announcement though.
Even though no one could get announcements as they were reserved for insane feats, this [Celestial] managed to continuously get them.
Leon did not care. He never cared about the noise.
Instead, he calmly opened his reputation panel.
[Reputation Points: 285]
"Nice."
That meant he had just crossed another important threshold.
And just as expected, new notifications appeared.
Ding!
[Your reputation has reached 250.]
[You will now gain an additional 50 attribute points per level.]
[You have received the "Reputable" title.]
[As a reward for your feats, your base attributes will be increased by 50%.]
Leon froze for a brief moment.
"Holy shit."
The additional 50 attribute points per level was something he expected.
That was the standard reward for reaching 250 Reputation Points.
The [Reputable] title was also something he had been waiting for.
But the base attributes increase? That was new.
Not only was gaining reputation points extremely difficult to begin with for most players.
Many in fact could never manage to reach 250.
Leon had once asked other players who managed to reach this threshold in the past.
They spoke about the [Reputable] title and some other small rewards.
But none of them ever mentioned a direct 50 percent increase to base attributes.
This was not a small reward. This was absurd.
If he had to guess, it was definitely linked to his [Celestial] title.
That title had already shown that it could amplify or modify certain rewards.
It would not be surprising if it enhanced milestone bonuses as well.
Leon grinned slightly.
"I wonder what I will get at 500."
If 250 gave him this much, then 500 would probably be something even more ridiculous.
Another panel appeared.
Ding!
[Do you wish to apply the 50% base attributes increase now?]
[Yes] [Yessir]
Leon did not immediately press either option.
His eyes shifted to another panel.
[Free Points to Allocate: 1,500.]
He had not allocated any points since reaching Level 30.
With the recent level ups and the bonus from [Heaven's Blessing], he had accumulated a massive amount.
He crossed his arms for a moment and thought carefully.
"Half in [Spirit], 500 in [Strength], and 250 in [Agility]," Leon said calmly.
The points were assigned instantly.
Fwoosh!
Power surged through his body. His muscles tightened. His senses sharpened. His mana pool expanded dramatically.
But he did not stop there.
Without hesitation, he pressed [Yessir].
BOOM!
It felt as if something exploded inside his body.
An overwhelming wave of energy burst outward from his core.
His entire body trembled violently as aura leaked from his skin.
The ground beneath his feet cracked slightly under the pressure.
His eyes turned white for a few seconds as the transformation completed.
Then everything settled down.
Ding!
[All your base attributes have increased by 50%.]
Leon inhaled slowly.
Of course, this only affected his base attributes. Equipment bonuses and sub talent boosts were calculated separately.
But even so, this was massive. He immediately opened his status window.
Because his base attributes had increased, every enhancement related to them also scaled upward.
And that meant one very important thing.
Leon stared at the number.
"...Damn."
He was nearly at 200,000 Combat Power.
Just a short while ago, the [Trace of God of Magic] had stood at 250,000.
Now, Leon was not that far behind.
Technically, his raw [Combat Power] was still slightly below that trace at full strength.
But in an actual battle, even without his [Celestial's Might], Leon felt like he might have won.
"Good," Leon muttered.
This growth would make the rest of the [Lower Domain] much easier to handle.
He knew several beings that could still challenge him, and the [Higher Domain] would still be very hard.
But for now, he was more than strong enough.
Satisfied, Leon turned his attention back to the pedestal at the end of the chamber.
The [Forbidden Spell Book] was glowing much more fiercely than before.
The light around it pulsed slowly, as if responding to his presence.
He considered using his [Blood Heart] for a moment.
But he shook his head. There was no point in using it now.
Most of his current equipment would eventually be replaced.
Using such a powerful blessing on temporary gear would be a waste.
The only pieces he planned to keep for a long time were the [Void Staff] and the [Elemental Dragon Armor], and both were already blessed.
It was stupid to waste the [Blood Heart] without a clear purpose, especially when he did not know how long it would take to recharge again.
He already knew what he wanted to use it on: the next sword he obtained.
'I'll be able to get a powerful sword with the item I wanted from [Myriad Race City] soon.'
With that thought settled, Leon began walking toward the pedestal.
His footsteps echoed in the empty chamber. The air felt different now.
After about a minute, he stood in front of the pedestal once again.
The last time he tried to take the book, it had rejected him violently.
"I really hope it does not explode this time," he sighed.
He extended his hand carefully. For a split second, nothing happened.
Then his fingers touched the cover.
He grasped it firmly and lifted it from the pedestal.
Ding!
[You have acquired the "Forbidden Spell Book".]
Leon did not waste time.
Fwoosh!
He immediately poured his mana into the book.
The cover glowed brightly. The pages flipped open on their own, moving rapidly as if guided by invisible hands.
Deep whispers echoed in his ears. They were not clear words, but they carried weight.
The energy radiating from the book was far greater than any normal skill book he had ever used.
Ding!
[You have used the "Forbidden Spell Book".]
[For showing such an amazing feat, you have been deemed worthy, and thus will receive a "Forbidden Spell".]
Leon took a slow breath.
"Here we go."
This was the true reward: a forbidden spell.
Something beyond normal magic. Something dangerous.
The whispers grew louder. Then the final panel appeared.
Ding!
[You have learned the forbidden spell: "Oblivion Meteor".]
Leon's eyes widened slightly.
"Damn."
I did not forget to show the [Reputable] title, it's for the next chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 117 117: The First Forbidden Spell, Oblivion Meteor
paragraphs: Ding!
[You have learned the forbidden spell: "Oblivion Meteor".]
Leon stood still for a moment after reading the notification.
Even in his past life, when he had reached heights that most players could only dream of, he had never managed to obtain a [Forbidden Spell] or a [Forbidden Skill].
They were simply too rare, powerful and heavily guarded.
Even top guild leaders, divine class players, and those who stood at the peak of the [Higher Domain] struggled to obtain one.
Many spent years chasing rumors. Some risked everything by making dangerous pacts.
Others tried to complete impossible quests that often ended in failure.
And one of the most common ways to obtain such power was to submit to a god.
Not every god granted forbidden abilities, since their domains differed.
Some gods offered blessings. Others offered unique skills or bloodline enhancements.
But the [God of Magic] was known for one thing.
Every one of his true servants received at least one [Forbidden Spell].
That alone made them terrifying.
If Leon ever encountered those individuals in the future, he would have to be extremely careful.
A forbidden spell was not something you could casually block or dodge.
Leon quickly opened his status panel to check the details.
[Forbidden Skills/Spells: Oblivion Meteor]
"Oh?"
He raised an eyebrow. A new category had appeared in his status window.
It was placed right below the [Skills] section, separated clearly from everything else.
Forbidden abilities were not ranked like normal skills.
They stood outside that system. They were in a category of their own.
Without wasting any time, Leon opened the new panel.
[Oblivion Meteor (Forbidden Spell): Channel the power of your spirit to summon a massive meteor from the heavens to annihilate all that is in your way.]
Leon read the description slowly. It was simple. But it was terrifying.
Unlike normal skills, forbidden abilities could not be leveled up.
They scaled directly with the user. The stronger the caster, the stronger the forbidden spell.
And with Leon's current [Spirit] stat, which had just undergone explosive growth, the destructive potential of this spell would be monstrous.
He did not need detailed numbers to understand that.
He could already imagine it. A meteor falling from the sky. Annihilating everything in its path.
Wiping out entire groups of enemies at once.
"I reckon it will take a lot out of me to use it," Leon muttered quietly.
Forbidden spells always had a cost. Some had massive cooldowns.
Some drained nearly all of the user's mana. Some consumed health.
And some had even more dangerous consequences.
The system did not show the cost directly in the description, which meant he would have to test it eventually.
He wanted to try it right now. He really did. But this was not the place.
Using a forbidden spell recklessly would be foolish.
He had just completed the [Secret Realm], and there was no enemy before him.
He would save it for a battle he might otherwise lose. Only then would it be worth the risk.
After confirming everything about his new spell, Leon finally allowed himself to relax slightly.
Fwoosh!
A portal appeared in front of him.
It shimmered softly, signaling the exit of the [Secret Realm].
Since the [Forbidden Spell Book] was unique, no one else would be able to complete this place again.
Many [Secret Realms] only allowed one true completion.
Once the main reward was claimed, the realm would disappear permanently.
Leon took one last look around the empty chamber.
Then he stepped forward and entered the portal.
Ding!
[The "Trace of Magic Chamber" secret realm will now permanently disappear.]
"Expected," Leon thought calmly as his body was enveloped by light.
Fwoosh!
A few seconds later, he emerged outside the [Star Magic Cave].
The first thing he noticed was the brightness. It was daytime.
Leon narrowed his eyes slightly.
"How long was I in there?"
Inside the [Secret Realm], it had felt like fifteen minutes at most. Maybe twenty.
But time often flowed differently in special spaces.
He quickly opened his [Friend List] and checked his friends.
Eleonore, David, Aliceand Aaron.
Their statuses all displayed the same thing: [Intermediate Divine Temple]
That meant they had reached Level 25 and were currently undergoing their second assessment.
'Good.'
That was faster than most players. As for Emilia, her status still showed [Lower Domain #1].
Leon immediately sent a message.
[Celestial: Hello. How long has it been?]
That was the most important question. If she replied, that meant she was safe.
A few seconds later, a response appeared.
[Saintess: Thank god you are back, it has been around six hours (ಥ_ಥ)]
Six hours. Leon did not react outwardly, but he felt relieved.
It was longer than he thought, but not disastrous.
[Celestial: Alright. I am heading back to "Myriad Race City" to deal with something there.]
Now that his strength had increased so dramatically, he felt confident.
Confident enough to challenge the lord of [Myriad Race City].
There was an item there he wanted. After that, he did not have much left to do in the [Lower Domain].
He could enter the [Farlands] using the token he possessed.
As for the [Shadow Assassin Guild] and the [Church of Light], there was little he could do for now.
Traveling between different [Lower Domains] was not something players could easily accomplish.
He clenched his jaw slightly.
"I really wanted to get rid of them while they are still weak," he thought.
But there was no clear method available to him at the moment.
All he could do was continue growing stronger.
Without wasting time, Leon began moving toward [Myriad Race City].
His increased [Agility] made the difference obvious.
Fwoosh!
He moved like a blur across the terrain. On the way, he passed the [Elven Stronghold].
It looked the same as before.
"They have not upgraded it yet," Leon thought. "Probably preparing for the [Monster Tide]."
It did not concern him. As long as they did not interfere with him, he had no reason to involve himself.
About fifteen minutes later, he reached a high vantage point where [Myriad Race City] came into view.
The massive city stood tall in the distance, its walls thick and imposing.
But Leon did not immediately advance. Instead, he stopped.
Around him, monsters and players were fighting in small groups, grinding for experience. S
houts and spell effects filled the air.
Leon ignored them. His gaze was fixed on the city.
A thought had just formed in his mind. A dangerous thought.
"Could I use that?" he wondered quietly.
His eyes shifted to his status panel. Specifically, to one line.
[Forbidden Skills/Spells: Oblivion Meteor]
If he used it here and targeted the city.
If he summoned a meteor from the heavens directly onto one of its defensive structures.
The result would be catastrophic.
Even if he did not destroy the entire city, the chaos alone would be unimaginable.
Players would panic. NPC guards would scramble. The city lord would be forced to appear.
It would be the fastest way to provoke a direct confrontation. But it would also paint a target on his back.
A forbidden spell was not subtle after all. Leon stood silently, staring at the distant walls.
And...
Ding!
[Saintess: I'm inside "Myriad Race City" waiting for you :3!]
"Yeah..." Leon sighed, "Nevermind."

Many [Secret Realms] only allowed one true completion.
Once the main reward was claimed, the realm would disappear permanently.
Leon took one last look around the empty chamber.
Then he stepped forward and entered the portal.
Ding!
[The "Trace of Magic Chamber" secret realm will now permanently disappear.]
"Expected," Leon thought calmly as his body was enveloped by light.
Fwoosh!
A few seconds later, he emerged outside the [Star Magic Cave].
The first thing he noticed was the brightness.
It was daytime.
Leon narrowed his eyes slightly.
"How long was I in there?"
Inside the [Secret Realm], it had felt like fifteen minutes at most.
Maybe twenty.
But time often flowed differently in special spaces.
He quickly opened his [Friend List] and checked his friends.
Eleonore, David, Aliceand Aaron.
Their statuses all displayed the same thing: [Intermediate Divine Temple]
That meant they had reached Level 25 and were currently undergoing their second assessment.
'Good.'
That was faster than most players.
As for Emilia, her status still showed [Lower Domain #1].
Leon immediately sent a message.
[Celestial: Hello.
How long has it been?]
That was the most important question.
If she replied, that meant she was safe.
A few seconds later, a response appeared.
[Saintess: Thank god you are back, it has been around six hours (ಥ_ಥ)]
Six hours.
Leon did not react outwardly, but he felt relieved.
It was longer than he thought, but not disastrous.
[Celestial: Alright.
I am heading back to "Myriad Race City" to deal with something there.]
Now that his strength had increased so dramatically, he felt confident.
Confident enough to challenge the lord of [Myriad Race City].
There was an item there he wanted.
After that, he did not have much left to do in the [Lower Domain].
He could enter the [Farlands] using the token he possessed.
As for the [Shadow Assassin Guild] and the [Church of Light], there was little he could do for now.
Traveling between different [Lower Domains] was not something players could easily accomplish.
He clenched his jaw slightly.
"I really wanted to get rid of them while they are still weak," he thought.
But there was no clear method available to him at the moment.
All he could do was continue growing stronger.
Without wasting time, Leon began moving toward [Myriad Race City].
His increased [Agility] made the difference obvious.
Fwoosh!
He moved like a blur across the terrain.
On the way, he passed the [Elven Stronghold].
It looked the same as before.
"They have not upgraded it yet," Leon thought.
"Probably preparing for the [Monster Tide]."
It did not concern him.
As long as they did not interfere with him, he had no reason to involve himself.
About fifteen minutes later, he reached a high vantage point where [Myriad Race City] came into view.
The massive city stood tall in the distance, its walls thick and imposing.
But Leon did not immediately advance.
Instead, he stopped.
Around him, monsters and players were fighting in small groups, grinding for experience.
S
houts and spell effects filled the air.
Leon ignored them.
His gaze was fixed on the city.
A thought had just formed in his mind.
A dangerous thought.
"Could I use that?" he wondered quietly.
His eyes shifted to his status panel.
Specifically, to one line.
[Forbidden Skills/Spells: Oblivion Meteor]
If he used it here and targeted the city.
If he summoned a meteor from the heavens directly onto one of its defensive structures.
The result would be catastrophic.
Even if he did not destroy the entire city, the chaos alone would be unimaginable.
Players would panic.
NPC guards would scramble.
The city lord would be forced to appear.
It would be the fastest way to provoke a direct confrontation.
But it would also paint a target on his back.
A forbidden spell was not subtle after all.
Leon stood silently, staring at the distant walls.
And...
Ding!
[Saintess: I'm inside "Myriad Race City" waiting for you :3!]
"Yeah..." Leon sighed, "Nevermind."

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Heading To The Lord’s Mansion, Fighting The Orc Guards
paragraphs: [Forbidden Spells] and [Forbidden Skills] were so powerful they could wipe out an entire city if needed.
Only a level 3 stronghold or higher had a real chance of surviving such devastation, and that was only because of the massive [Barrier] placed around those cities.
Those barriers were designed specifically to endure catastrophic attacks.
Without them, the result would be simple: total annihilation.
And for a spell named [Oblivion Meteor], Leon did not need the system to spell it out for him.
The name alone suggested overwhelming destruction.
Even so, Leon could not act recklessly.
[Myriad Race City] was filled with players who had done nothing wrong.
Many were simply grinding levels. Some were preparing for their next assessment. And Emilia was there too.
He needed to be careful. He had never used a [Forbidden Spell] before.
He did not know how precise his control would be or the range.
He did not know how far the impact zone would stretch.
If he misjudged it, the consequences would be irreversible.
Leon took a slow breath and pushed those thoughts aside for now.
There was another way to achieve what he wanted.
He rushed forward toward the city.
[Celestial: I am here.]
After a few minutes of moving at full speed, he reached the gate entrance of [Myriad Race City].
The towering walls loomed over him as usual, guarded by massive orcs clad in heavy armor.
’The [Orc Lord Orb] will definitely help me get what I want,’ Leon thought.
That item was the true objective.
The only way to obtain it was by defeating the lord of [Myriad Race City].
Doing so would immediately place a target on his back.
Every orc guard in the city would hunt him down.
Bounties would also be issued. He would become an enemy of the entire city.
But the reward was worth it.
The [Orc Lord Orb] was an extremely powerful item with unique properties.
Leon could use it to obtain high grade equipment, equipment that would be useful even after entering the [Higher Domain].
’I will be able to get good equipment with it,’ he thought with a faint grin.
And with the [Blood Heart] fully recharged, he would also be able to bless whatever he acquired.
That combination alone made the risk worthwhile.
Leon was allowed inside the city without issue.
The guards did not recognize him as a threat yet.
In the main square, he quickly spotted Emilia waiting.
As he approached her, he activated [Appraisal] to check her current state.
[Name: Emilia Verdant]
[ID: Saintess]
[Level: 43]
[Title: Support Saint, Magic Saint]
[World: Verdia (High-Level)]
[Talent: Elven Saintess (SS-Level)]
[Sub-Talents: Agility Enhancement (D-Level), Poison Resistance (D-Level), Super Constitution Enhancement (B-Level)], Spirit Enhancement (D-Level)]
[Skills: Appraisal (Common Lv.3), Agility Enhancement (Common Lv.3), Divine Beam (Elite Lv.3), Strength Buff (Rare Lv.1), Spectral Flames (Epic Lv.2), Speed Buff (Lv.1), Silk Bind (Lv.1)]
[Combat Power: 236,614]
Leon stared at her [Combat Power] without changing his expression.

’I mean, every time she levels up she gains 100 points in every attribute and 100 free points,’ he thought. ’With her titles boosting Spirit and Constitution by five times, that alone is insane growth.’
On top of that, she had solid equipment and useful sub talents.
When everything was calculated together, her combat power made sense.
Still, seeing the number directly in front of him was shocking.
He was closing the gap between them quickly despite her massive multipliers, but Emilia’s growth remained monstrous.
For what he planned to do next, her strength would be important.
"Alright," Leon said calmly, a faint grin forming. "Time to head to the [Lord Mansion]."
The lord of [Myriad Race City] was infamous.
He was powerful enough that almost no player dared challenge him.
Those who tried were usually crushed. And even if someone managed to kill him, he would respawn later, stronger and more prepared, sending waves of guards after the offender.
"I plan to get the item I want and then we will immediately head for the [Farlands]," Leon added.
"Alright," Emilia replied without hesitation.
They left the main square and moved deeper into the city.
They passed by the square where the [Myriad Arena Gate] stood.
The last time they had been here, they had stopped. This time, they did not even glance at it.
"Why do you want to kill him this badly?" Emilia asked as they moved. "Is it really only for the item?"
"Not just that," Leon answered. "But explaining it would not change anything."
Players were not the only ones capable of submitting to gods and becoming servants.
Natives of [Eternal Ascension] could do the same.
The [God of Magic’s Disciple] in the [Star Magic Cave] had been a native, not a player.
That meant the threats Leon needed to eliminate were not limited to players alone.
Even if he removed every player aligned with hostile gods, countless natives could still exist in hidden corners of the world.
The situation was more complicated than it appeared.
Eventually, the [Lord’s Mansion] came into view.
It was a massive structure built from dark stone, guarded by dozens of heavily armed orcs.
Their armor gleamed under the daylight, and their weapons looked large enough to crush normal players in a single strike.
"What do we do?" Emilia asked, tightening her grip on her scepter.
"We attack," Leon replied simply. "Do not slow down. I want this finished quickly."
Emilia nodded and immediately raised her scepter.
Strength Buff! Speed Buff!
Warm energy surged through Leon’s body as the buffs took effect.
His muscles felt lighter. His movements sharpened.
The orc guards noticed them approaching and quickly formed a defensive line.
"A filthy human and elf," one of the orcs sneered.
"What do we do?" another asked with a grin.
"Kill them," a third responded. "The lord has ordered us to eliminate anyone who approaches too closely, even by mistake."
The orcs laughed among themselves.
Orcs, whether players or natives, were known for their monstrous strength and durability.
They prided themselves on overpowering other races. They believed humans and elves were inferior.
And yet...
SLASH!
Leon’s blade flashed.
One of the orcs was split cleanly in half before he could even raise his weapon.
The body collapsed heavily onto the stone ground. The other guards stared for a fraction of a second.
"Huh?"
But they did not hesitate.
To orcs, dying to a supposedly inferior race simply meant weakness. They felt no shame. They felt no fear.
Leon activated [Appraisal] again.
The first time he had tried to inspect these guards upon arriving in the city, the system had prevented him.
This time, it worked.
[Myriad City Orc Guard]
[Level: 50]
[Talent: Super Strength Enhancement (C-Level)]
[Combat Power: 140,000]
[Details: The guards of "Myriad Race City", orcs that like to fight other beings and consider all other races inferior.]
"Hm."
Their combat power was extremely high. Years of training and their racial bonuses made them overwhelming opponents for most players in the [Lower Domain].
But unfortunately for them, they were facing Leon and Emilia. Two of the strongest players in this entire domain.
This was not a fair fight. Leon already knew that.
"I will be taking your sub-talents," Leon said calmly, a faint grin forming as he rushed forward again.
His sword moved like a streak of light. Another orc fell.
Behind him, Emilia planted her feet firmly on the ground. Her eyes focused as she gathered spirit energy.
Light gathered at the tip of her scepter. It intensified rapidly.
And then... She fired a [Divine Beam].

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Killing The Orc Guards, A-Level Mega Strength Enhancement
paragraphs: Slash! Boom!
Steel cut through flesh and bone while spells shook the entrance of the [Lord Mansion].
The wide stone courtyard in front of the building had already turned into a battlefield.
Orc guards rushed forward in waves, roaring and swinging their weapons, but neither Leon nor Emilia showed the slightest hesitation anymore.
At this point, killing had become routine.
The two of them moved with cold efficiency.
Leon stepped forward and sliced through an orc’s chest as if he were cutting through paper.
Emilia raised her staff and released a burst of magic that blasted three guards away at once.
Blood stained the stone floor. Heavy bodies fell one after another.
At this point, they were used to kill monsters and natives alike.
Because even though Earth and Verdia used to be extremely peaceful worlds, now that they were here, it didn’t matter.
This world was not Earth, and it did not care about morals, laws, or the comfort of peaceful societies.
In [Eternal Ascension], killing others was the only way forward.
Players had to abandon their old beliefs or be swallowed by the system.
Leon understood that better than most.
He had adapted quickly. Too quickly, perhaps.
For Leon, he already knew that, as he was used to it and had become desensitized.
What surprised him more was Emilia. She had grown up in a far more peaceful environment.
She had not been exposed to violence the way Leon had.
And yet, here she was, blasting apart orc guards without flinching.
There was no trembling in her hands. No pause in her spells.
She had accepted this world just as quickly as he had.
The last orc guard tried to run, but Leon stepped forward and drove his blade straight through its back.
The courtyard fell silent.
After only around a minute, dozens of bodies lay scattered across the stone ground.
Ding.
[You have killed 32 "Myriad City Orc Guard" and gained 128,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
Ding.
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 41!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 200 points in all attributes and 200 free points to distribute.]
The familiar wave of warmth spread through Leon’s body as his attributes rose.
But the notifications were not done yet.
Ding!
["Celestial Hand" has activated on "Myriad City Orc Guard"]
Leon narrowed his eyes slightly.
"Oh? I guess it does work on natives too. I should have expected that."
The description of [Celestial Hand] clearly said "enemy." It did not specify monsters only.
Still, seeing it activate on actual intelligent natives confirmed something important.
If it worked on them, then the potential was far greater than he originally thought.
He doubted it would trigger on real players. If it did, that would be terrifying.
But for now, this was already enough.
Without hesitation, Leon selected the sub-talents from the fallen orc guards.
The equipment and materials were mediocre at best, but the sub-talents had value.
Celestial Hand!
Several glowing, semi-transparent hands burst out from Leon’s chest.
They stretched forward and plunged into the corpses of the orcs, as if reaching into another layer of existence.
Fwoosh!
The hands retracted, pulling invisible rewards into Leon’s inventory.
Leon opened his inventory panel and frowned slightly. It was getting crowded.
[Orc Guard Armor x32 (Uncommon)], [Orc Guard Sword x32 (Common)], and [Sub-Talent Scroll: x36 Strength Enhancement (C-Level)] filled up most of the remaining space.
The equipment was not bad for average players, but for Leon, it wasn’t that good except for the [Orc Guard Sword].
And it was only slightly better than his current one.
’I’ll be able to obtain a much better sword very soon,’ he thought, ’Might as well sell them.’
Instead of keeping them, he immediately opened the [Trading House] interface.
He placed all the unnecessary items for sale, including the remaining [Star Mage Staffs] he had acquired earlier and several pieces of gear he did not need.
He kept only materials and anything that had long-term potential.
The moment he confirmed the listings, before he even had time to close the panel, notifications began flooding in.
Ding.
[You have sold x10 "Orc Guard Armor" for 3,000 Eternal Coins.]
[You have sold "Star Mage Staff +4" for 2,200 Eternal Coins.]
"...Damn."
The notifications continued one after another.
Ding! Ding! Ding!
Each item he listed was being purchased almost instantly.
Within moments, everything was gone. Leon let out a low whistle.
"I think I underestimated the reach my ID has."
Players in [Lower Domain #1] recognized him.
Whether out of admiration, curiosity, or greed, they were watching his listings.
Anything he sold was also extremely useful for other players who couldn’t get enemies to drop items.
The [Trading House] was currently limited to [Lower Domain #1] only. It did not connect to the other domains.
Leon could only imagine what would happen if the system opened it to everyone across all Lower Domains.
The competition would be brutal.
And that was exactly why the [Higher Domain] was far more dangerous.
The markets were interconnected. Strong players from countless regions competed directly.
For now, though, Leon checked his balance.
[Eternal Coins: 39,296]
"Nice."
That was a substantial amount for the [Lower Domain].
With that many coins, he could upgrade his [Storage Space] again, adding ten more slots.
But Leon did not do it immediately. He closed the panel and shook his head slightly.
"I’ll need far more than this in the future," he muttered. "This is not nearly enough."
Upgrading blindly now might limit him later if something more important appeared.
After that, his attention shifted to the sub-talent scrolls.
He picked up four of them and tossed them toward Emilia.
"Here. I know you don’t rely on Strength much, but it is still useful to have."
Emilia caught them and smiled brightly.
"Thanks."
She immediately poured her mana into one of the scrolls.
The parchment dissolved into light and flowed into her body.
Then she used the remaining scrolls to fuse and upgrade it.
Beep!
Two fusions failed. She tried again.
Ding!
This time, it succeeded.
By the end, her Strength Enhancement sub-talent had risen to B-Level.
Even if she was primarily a mage, extra strength meant better survivability.
If she ever needed to wield a weapon or resist physical force, it would help.
As for Leon, he focused on his own stack of scrolls. He began fusing them methodically.
Ding!
[Fusion successful.]
Beep!
[Fusion failed.]
Again.
Ding! Beep!
The failures did not bother him. He had enough scrolls to brute-force his way upward.
Eventually, only a handful remained.
[Sub-Talent Scrolls: x6 Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level), Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)]
A slow grin spread across his face.
"Nice."
He did not hesitate. Leon poured his mana into the A-Level scroll and tore it apart.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have upgraded your "Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)" sub-talent to "Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)"]
[Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level): Permanently increases strength by 100%.]
A surge of power flooded through his body.
If his sword strikes had been deadly before, they were now monstrous.
Satisfied, Leon closed his panels and looked toward the towering structure ahead.
The [Lord’s Mansion] stood tall, built from dark stone, radiating authority and intimidation.
He stepped forward.
"I want to finish this quickly," he said quietly.
The [Orc Lord Orb] was dropped directly by the city’s ruler.
There was no way around it. To obtain it, he had to defeat the lord himself.
They moved through the courtyard carefully.
Then, without warning, a deep voice echoed behind them.
"I see now..."
The air shifted. A massive figure appeared behind Leon and Emilia as if he had been standing there the entire time.
"I will get rid of the girl first, she seems annoying."
Leon’s instincts screamed. He spun around instantly.
The being standing before them was enormous, nearly two and a half meters tall.
His skin was deep green. Thick muscles covered his entire body, veins clearly visible under his skin.
He wore nothing on his chest, only a pair of dark pants. His presence alone felt crushing.
Leon activated Appraisal immediately.
[Myriad Race City Lord, Ghorak]
[Level: 50]
[Exclusive Talent: Orc City Lord (A-Level)]
[Talent: Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)]
[Combat Power: 285,000]
[Details: The lord of "Myriad Race City" and one of the strongest natives in the "Lower Domain", able to overpower almost anyone thanks to his incredible strength.]
Two hundred eighty-five thousand combat power. Leon’s pupils shrank slightly.
Swash!
Ghorak swung a massive machete engraved with a skull symbol.
The blade cut through the air and aimed directly at Emilia’s neck without hesitation.
Emilia barely had time to react.
The sheer aura behind that attack told Leon everything he needed to know.
If that blade landed cleanly, she would not survive, or at least be massively injured.
Leon moved instantly.
Slash!
He stepped in front of Emilia and swung his own sword upward, intercepting the machete.
The two weapons collided violently.
Clang!
The impact shook the ground.
"Ah!" Emilia stumbled backward in shock. "O-Oh shit!"
"Not bad," Ghorak said with a savage grin as he pressed down harder. "But unfortunately, you are just a human."
The pressure increased. Leon felt it immediately.
Despite his newly doubled strength, despite his upgrades, the force behind Ghorak’s swing was overwhelming.
Bam!
Ghorak forced Leon back several steps with raw power alone.
At least Emilia was safe. That was enough for now.
Leon steadied himself and glanced down instinctively.
"Oh."
His expression froze. His [Undead Sword +3] had shattered completely from the clash.
Fragments of blackened steel fell to the ground.
But that was not the worst part: Leon’s arm hung at an unnatural angle. The bones were broken.
The impact had not only destroyed his weapon. It had crushed his arm as well.
And Ghorak was still smiling.

She had accepted this world just as quickly as he had.
The last orc guard tried to run, but Leon stepped forward and drove his blade straight through its back.
The courtyard fell silent.
After only around a minute, dozens of bodies lay scattered across the stone ground.
Ding.
[You have killed 32 "Myriad City Orc Guard" and gained 128,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
Ding.
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 41!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing", you have gained 200 points in all attributes and 200 free points to distribute.]
The familiar wave of warmth spread through Leon’s body as his attributes rose.
But the notifications were not done yet.
Ding!
["Celestial Hand" has activated on "Myriad City Orc Guard"]
Leon narrowed his eyes slightly.
"Oh?
I guess it does work on natives too.
I should have expected that."
The description of [Celestial Hand] clearly said "enemy." It did not specify monsters only.
Still, seeing it activate on actual intelligent natives confirmed something important.
If it worked on them, then the potential was far greater than he originally thought.
He doubted it would trigger on real players.
If it did, that would be terrifying.
But for now, this was already enough.
Without hesitation, Leon selected the sub-talents from the fallen orc guards.
The equipment and materials were mediocre at best, but the sub-talents had value.
Celestial Hand!
Several glowing, semi-transparent hands burst out from Leon’s chest.
They stretched forward and plunged into the corpses of the orcs, as if reaching into another layer of existence.
Fwoosh!
The hands retracted, pulling invisible rewards into Leon’s inventory.
Leon opened his inventory panel and frowned slightly.
It was getting crowded.
[Orc Guard Armor x32 (Uncommon)], [Orc Guard Sword x32 (Common)], and [Sub-Talent Scroll: x36 Strength Enhancement (C-Level)] filled up most of the remaining space.
The equipment was not bad for average players, but for Leon, it wasn’t that good except for the [Orc Guard Sword].
And it was only slightly better than his current one.
’I’ll be able to obtain a much better sword very soon,’ he thought, ’Might as well sell them.’
Instead of keeping them, he immediately opened the [Trading House] interface.
He placed all the unnecessary items for sale, including the remaining [Star Mage Staffs] he had acquired earlier and several pieces of gear he did not need.
He kept only materials and anything that had long-term potential.
The moment he confirmed the listings, before he even had time to close the panel, notifications began flooding in.
Ding.
[You have sold x10 "Orc Guard Armor" for 3,000 Eternal Coins.]
[You have sold "Star Mage Staff +4" for 2,200 Eternal Coins.]
"...Damn."
The notifications continued one after another.
Ding!
Ding!
Ding!
Each item he listed was being purchased almost instantly.
Within moments, everything was gone.
Leon let out a low whistle.
"I think I underestimated the reach my ID has."
Players in [Lower Domain #1] recognized him.
Whether out of admiration, curiosity, or greed, they were watching his listings.
Anything he sold was also extremely useful for other players who couldn’t get enemies to drop items.
The [Trading House] was currently limited to [Lower Domain #1] only.
It did not connect to the other domains.
Leon could only imagine what would happen if the system opened it to everyone across all Lower Domains.
The competition would be brutal.
And that was exactly why the [Higher Domain] was far more dangerous.
The markets were interconnected.
Strong players from countless regions competed directly.
For now, though, Leon checked his balance.
[Eternal Coins: 39,296]
"Nice."
That was a substantial amount for the [Lower Domain].
With that many coins, he could upgrade his [Storage Space] again, adding ten more slots.
But Leon did not do it immediately.
He closed the panel and shook his head slightly.
"I’ll need far more than this in the future," he muttered.
"This is not nearly enough."
Upgrading blindly now might limit him later if something more important appeared.
After that, his attention shifted to the sub-talent scrolls.
He picked up four of them and tossed them toward Emilia.
"Here.
I know you don’t rely on Strength much, but it is still useful to have."
Emilia caught them and smiled brightly.
"Thanks."
She immediately poured her mana into one of the scrolls.
The parchment dissolved into light and flowed into her body.
Then she used the remaining scrolls to fuse and upgrade it.
Beep!
Two fusions failed.
She tried again.
Ding!
This time, it succeeded.
By the end, her Strength Enhancement sub-talent had risen to B-Level.
Even if she was primarily a mage, extra strength meant better survivability.
If she ever needed to wield a weapon or resist physical force, it would help.
As for Leon, he focused on his own stack of scrolls.
He began fusing them methodically.
Ding!
[Fusion successful.]
Beep!
[Fusion failed.]
Again.
Ding!
Beep!
The failures did not bother him.
He had enough scrolls to brute-force his way upward.
Eventually, only a handful remained.
[Sub-Talent Scrolls: x6 Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level), Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)]
A slow grin spread across his face.
"Nice."
He did not hesitate.
Leon poured his mana into the A-Level scroll and tore it apart.
Ding!
[Congratulations, you have upgraded your "Super Strength Enhancement (B-Level)" sub-talent to "Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)"]
[Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level): Permanently increases strength by 100%.]
A surge of power flooded through his body.
If his sword strikes had been deadly before, they were now monstrous.
Satisfied, Leon closed his panels and looked toward the towering structure ahead.
The [Lord’s Mansion] stood tall, built from dark stone, radiating authority and intimidation.
He stepped forward.
"I want to finish this quickly," he said quietly.
The [Orc Lord Orb] was dropped directly by the city’s ruler.
There was no way around it.
To obtain it, he had to defeat the lord himself.
They moved through the courtyard carefully.
Then, without warning, a deep voice echoed behind them.
"I see now..."
The air shifted.
A massive figure appeared behind Leon and Emilia as if he had been standing there the entire time.
"I will get rid of the girl first, she seems annoying."
Leon’s instincts screamed.
He spun around instantly.
The being standing before them was enormous, nearly two and a half meters tall.
His skin was deep green.
Thick muscles covered his entire body, veins clearly visible under his skin.
He wore nothing on his chest, only a pair of dark pants.
His presence alone felt crushing.
Leon activated Appraisal immediately.
[Myriad Race City Lord, Ghorak]
[Level: 50]
[Exclusive Talent: Orc City Lord (A-Level)]
[Talent: Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)]
[Combat Power: 285,000]
[Details: The lord of "Myriad Race City" and one of the strongest natives in the "Lower Domain", able to overpower almost anyone thanks to his incredible strength.]
Two hundred eighty-five thousand combat power.
Leon’s pupils shrank slightly.
Swash!
Ghorak swung a massive machete engraved with a skull symbol.
The blade cut through the air and aimed directly at Emilia’s neck without hesitation.
Emilia barely had time to react.
The sheer aura behind that attack told Leon everything he needed to know.
If that blade landed cleanly, she would not survive, or at least be massively injured.
Leon moved instantly.
Slash!
He stepped in front of Emilia and swung his own sword upward, intercepting the machete.
The two weapons collided violently.
Clang!
The impact shook the ground.
"Ah!" Emilia stumbled backward in shock.
"O-Oh shit!"
"Not bad," Ghorak said with a savage grin as he pressed down harder.
"But unfortunately, you are just a human."
The pressure increased.
Leon felt it immediately.
Despite his newly doubled strength, despite his upgrades, the force behind Ghorak’s swing was overwhelming.
Bam!
Ghorak forced Leon back several steps with raw power alone.
At least Emilia was safe.
That was enough for now.
Leon steadied himself and glanced down instinctively.
"Oh."
His expression froze.
His [Undead Sword +3] had shattered completely from the clash.
Fragments of blackened steel fell to the ground.
But that was not the worst part: Leon’s arm hung at an unnatural angle.
The bones were broken.
The impact had not only destroyed his weapon.
It had crushed his arm as well.
And Ghorak was still smiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: The Myriad Race City Lord Ghorak, A Broken Arm is Nothing!
paragraphs: Leon looked down at his shattered sword and then at his twisted arm.
The bone had clearly snapped from the impact.
The pain should have been unbearable, yet his expression did not change.
With his sword destroyed and his dominant arm broken, it meant one simple thing: he could not fight physically anymore.
"O-Oh shit," Emilia gasped.
It was the first time she had ever seen Leon truly injured.
Until now, he had always stood at the front, overwhelming enemies with cold precision.
Seeing his weapon shattered and his arm bent unnaturally was shocking.
Worse, she did not have any healing spells. Her magic focused on buffs and offensive power.

"You truly are no match for an orc’s strength, pathetic human," Ghorak laughed as he stepped forward, rolling his shoulders as if warming up for another strike. "But do not worry. The pain will end soon."
The moment he had sensed his guards being slaughtered, Ghorak had not hesitated.
As the strongest being in this city, it would have been foolish to sit inside his mansion and wait for invaders to reach him.
He had come personally. And now, seeing Leon injured, his confidence only grew.
Without another word, Ghorak dashed forward.
His massive frame moved far faster than his size suggested.
The machete in his hand sliced through the air as he aimed directly at Leon’s torso.
Divine Beam!
Emilia reacted instantly this time. Light exploded from the tip of her scepter and shot toward Ghorak in a blinding column.
The orc lord clicked his tongue and shifted his path mid charge.
Instead of continuing forward, he pivoted and dodged to the side, the beam barely missing him and striking the ground behind.
The stone exploded where it landed.
’That guy is fast,’ Leon thought calmly. ’He can dodge her spells if he focuses.’
Emilia hurried to Leon’s side, her face pale with worry as she grabbed his uninjured arm.
"Are you hurt?" she asked urgently. Her eyes fell on the twisted limb and she grimaced. "Damn it..."
"It’s fine," Leon replied with a blank expression. "I don’t feel a thing."
Compared to what he had endured in his previous life, a broken arm was nothing.
Pain did not scare him. It barely registered anymore.
Still, a broken arm was inconvenient.
Fwoosh!
Leon opened his [Storage Space] and pulled out a small glass vial filled with glowing liquid.
[Healing Potion: May fully heal injuries.]
He had obtained three of these from the [Legendary Treasure Chest] in [Novice Village #1] after being the first to reach level ten.
He had never needed to use them until now. A broken arm was something the potion could handle.
If it had been a severed limb, the situation would have been far more complicated.
Gulp!
He swallowed the potion in one motion.
Warmth flooded his body instantly. It spread from his chest to his shoulders and down into his broken arm.
The twisted bone straightened. The damaged tissue repaired itself.
Within a single second, his arm was completely restored.
Leon flexed his fingers once. Good as new.
’I will need stronger potions in the future,’ he thought calmly.
However, one problem remained: his [Undead Sword +3] was still shattered beyond repair.
Ghorak cracked his knuckles and watched with amusement.
"Well, if you can heal yourself, that simply means I will have to hurt you more," he laughed loudly. "Come here, guards."
From different sides of the courtyard, ten more orc guards rushed in.
Their eyes burned with fury as they saw the bodies of their fallen comrades.
"Avenge your brothers if you wish," Ghorak ordered, pointing his machete toward Emilia. "Leave the human to me. Get rid of the girl."
The guards roared in unison, their bloodlust filling the air.
"As for you," Ghorak said, locking eyes with Leon, "your magic will not even scratch me."
Leon already understood why.
With the [City Lord] talent and his natural racial advantages, Ghorak possessed extremely high magic resistance. Most spells would barely injure him.
This was a troublesome opponent. But Leon would not have come here if he believed he could not win.
’First,’ Leon thought as he glanced at the approaching guards, ’I need a weapon.’
He raised his staff without hesitation.
Storm of Lightning!
The sky above darkened for a split second as bolts of lightning rained down across the courtyard.
Electricity struck the orc guards one after another, surging through their armor and bodies.
Even Ghorak was hit. The orc lord did not move.
The lightning crawled across his skin but he stood firm, a wide grin still on his face.
"Do you not understand?" he began mockingly. "I told you that magic will not do anything to—"
He stopped mid sentence as all ten of his guards were frozen in place. Stunned.
He had expected the elf to wield powerful magic, but not the human to do the same.
Before he could react further, Emilia seized the opportunity.
Spectral Flames!
Ghostly fire erupted around the stunned orc guards, engulfing them in pale blue flames.
They could not move. They could not defend themselves.
The flames consumed them completely.
Ding.
[You have killed 10 "Myriad City Orc Guard" and gained 35,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
The bodies fell one after another.
Ghorak did not even glance at them as he charged forward again.
Emilia’s flames left faint scorch marks on his chest and shoulders, but he barely reacted.
His magic resistance truly was exceptional.
He swung his machete once more at Leon, confident that the human was unarmed.
Clang!
Ghorak’s eyes narrowed as he noticed Leon with a new weapon.
"Too bad," Leon said with a faint grin, "your guards just gave me a new sword.
When the ten guards died, ten [Orc Guard Sword] had entered Leon’s [Storage Space].
In the brief moment before Ghorak reached him, Leon had opened his inventory and begun fusing them rapidly.
Fwoosh! Ding!
[You have consumed two identical equipment... enhancement successful.]
Again.
Fwoosh! Ding!
He repeated the process until only one weapon remained.
[Orc Guard Sword +3 (Common): +2,000 Attack, +1,200 Strength, +500 Agility. Requirement: 3,000 Strength.]
The strength requirement was high. For many players, it would have been impossible to wield effectively.
Leon did not have that problem.
With his enhanced attributes and newly upgraded sub talent, his strength easily surpassed the requirement.
Their weapons clashed again. This time, Leon could actually block.
Still, Ghorak’s raw power was monstrous. Each swing carried immense force.
The ground beneath Leon’s feet cracked as he was slowly pushed backward.
"This time," Ghorak roared as his muscles bulged further, veins standing out along his arms, "I am not moving... You die here, human."
Leon gritted his teeth slightly as he held the blade steady.
He was stronger, but Ghorak was still overwhelming.
But unlike before, Emilia wouldn’t make the mistake of remaining stunned and doing nothing.
She pointed her scepter directly toward Leon.
Strength Buff!
Immediately, warm light enveloped Leon, and his strength doubled.
Because his base strength was already extremely high, doubling it pushed him to a completely different level.
Leon’s arms steadied. His feet stopped sliding backward. And then he pushed.
Ghorak’s grin faltered as he was forced a step back. Then another.
With a powerful surge, Leon shoved the orc lord several meters away.
"I knew the elf would be annoying," Ghorak growled, glaring at Emilia with undisguised hostility. "No matter, this changes nothing."
For a split second, Ghorak closed his eyes.
When he opened them again, they were completely black.
Lord’s Domain!
The air shifted instantly. Darkness spread across the courtyard like a heavy fog.
The sky dimmed. The atmosphere thickened as if something enormous had descended upon them.
Leon felt it immediately. The mana around him disappeared.
"In my domain," Ghorak said as he flexed his arms and grinned, "no magic is allowed, so show me your true strength."
Emilia’s eyes widened. She tried to channel aa spell from her scepter, but nothing happened.
Her connection to magic had been cut off entirely.
Leon’s expression darkened slightly.
’This is bad,’ he thought. ’He is much stronger than I expected.’

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Defeating Ghorak with Magic, S-Level Supreme Strength Enhancement
paragraphs: The moment the darkness of the [Lord’s Domain] settled completely around them, Emilia felt it: she couldn’t cast her spells.
She instinctively lifted her scepter and tried to gather mana like she always did.
Divine Beam! Spectral Flames!
Nothing happened. No warmth formed at the tip of her weapon.
It was as if someone had cut an invisible thread that linked her to the world itself.
She tried again, forcing more focus. Still nothing.
Her mana was there inside her body, but she could not draw it out. It felt sealed.
Leon watched her reaction from the corner of his eye and immediately understood what was happening.
’This is the complete opposite of the [Trace of Magic Chamber],’ he thought with a faint grin. ’Instead of cutting off strength, this guy is cutting off magic.’
It was a terrifying ability. Any mage who entered this domain would instantly become useless.
Emilia, who relied heavily on magic for offense, had just lost most of her power in a single moment.
If someone like her were hit by such a restriction during a serious fight, it would immediately turn into a physical battle.
And in a battle of pure strength, Ghorak was among the strongest beings in the entire [Lower Domain].
It was completely unfair. Ghorak’s grin widened as he flexed his arms.
"Without magic, both of you are defenseless," he declared confidently. "You might as well accept your deaths."
There was not a hint of doubt in his voice.
No one who had entered his domain had ever survived.
Every invader, every challenger, had fallen the moment their magic disappeared.
And those that didn’t use it to begin with stood no chance either.
"How about this," Ghorak continued, pointing his machete at Leon. "I will allow a one on one battle between the two of us. You seem strong enough to entertain me."
Leon did not respond. He simply stared at him.
"Otherwise," Ghorak added with a cruel smile, "I will kill your girlfriend first and then deal with—"
Powerful Fireball! Ice Spikes!
Before Ghorak could even finish his sentence, a massive fireball formed at the tip of Leon’s staff and shot forward at full speed.
"What?"
Ghorak’s eyes widened.
In the decades he had ruled this city, no one had ever been able to use magic inside his [Lord’s Domain].
And yet...
BOOM!
The fireball exploded directly against his chest. The impact forced him to raise his arm to shield his face as he stumbled backward.
Before he could fully recover, a sharp pillar of ice erupted from the ground behind him.
It did not pierce completely through his body, but it tore into his back hard enough to draw blood.
"You..." Ghorak roared, aura pouring out of his darkened eyes as he glared forward. "You can use magic in my domain?"
But when he focused his gaze forward, Leon was gone.
"Huh?"
Shadow Slash!
Leon appeared behind him as if stepping out of thin air.
His sword was already mid swing, infused with dark energy that shimmered along the blade.
Ghorak reacted fast. He twisted his body and raised his machete to protect his neck.
It was not enough.
SLASH!
The shadow infused strike cut cleanly through one of Ghorak’s arms.
The massive limb fell to the ground with a heavy thud. Blood sprayed across the darkened domain.
Leon did not stay close. He immediately retreated, returning to Emilia’s side to protect her in case Ghorak lashed out blindly.
The reason he could use magic was simple: [Unaffected.]
The passive ability granted by his [Celestial] title prevented him from being altered by rules or status effects that changed how he normally functioned.
Just like it had allowed him to use strength in the [Trace of Magic Chamber], it now allowed him to use magic in the [Lord’s Domain].
The domain could suppress others. It could not suppress him.
Even after losing an arm, Ghorak did not collapse.
His breathing grew heavier, but his eyes burned with fury.
"As long as I land one good hit," he muttered under his breath, tightening his grip on the machete with his remaining hand, "you die."
He had already confirmed something: the elf girl could not use magic. Only the human could.
If he eliminated Leon, the battle would end immediately.
With a furious roar, Ghorak dashed forward again.
"Emilia," Leon said calmly, "buffs are technically not considered as magic."
That was all he said before rushing forward himself.
Even with only one arm, Ghorak swung his machete with terrifying force.
Their blades collided but...
Strength Buff!
Emilia understood instantly. Even if she could not cast offensive spells, support abilities might not fall under the same restriction.
A surge of energy flowed into Leon. His strength doubled.
Clang!
This time, when their weapons met, Leon did not budge.
Slash! Slash!
They exchanged blow after blow, steel colliding violently in the darkened domain.
Despite having only one arm, Ghorak’s raw power was still monstrous.
Each swing carried crushing force. However, Leon was no longer at a disadvantage.
In fact, he had something Ghorak did not: versatility.
Storm of Elements!
The skill embedded within his [Elemental Dragon Armor] activated, and the environment shifted.
Flames ignited around them, swirling embers dancing through the air.
Water condensed into heavy droplets that disrupted footing.
The ground trembled as earth energy rippled outward.
Violent gusts of wind pushed unpredictably against Ghorak’s movements.
"That is why I hate magic," Ghorak growled, his expression darkening.
Even though he despised it, he increased the intensity of his attacks. His swings became wilder, stronger, more desperate.
Leon noticed something: [Celestial’s Might] had not activated once more.
There truly seemed to be a third condition he did not fully understand yet, perhaps something related to direct attribute comparison.
Or perhaps it was because Emilia was by his side? It did not matter.
The environmental chaos combined with Leon’s continuous spell casting was overwhelming.
Fireballs detonated at close range. Ice shards erupted from unexpected angles.
Even with immense magic resistance, he was taking damage repeatedly.
And after only about a minute, Ghorak’s body was covered in burns and cuts.
His breathing became ragged. His movements slowed.
Leon seized the opportunity.
With a powerful swing, he knocked the machete out of Ghorak’s hand.
The weapon flew several meters away and embedded itself into the ground.
There was no hesitation. Leon stepped forward and swung horizontally at full force.
"You—"
SLASH!
Ghorak’s head separated from his body.
For a brief second, the massive figure remained standing. Then it collapsed.
Ding!
[You have killed "Myriad Race City Lord, Ghorak" and gained 400,000 experience points.]
[100% Drop Rate has triggered...]
The darkness of the [Lord’s Domain] slowly faded as the skill ended with its caster’s death.
Light returned to the courtyard. Leon and Emilia both felt their experience bars surge upward.
Ding.
[Congratulations, you have leveled up to Level 42 + Level 43 + Level 44!]
[Due to "Heaven’s Blessing," you have gained 600 points in all attributes and 600 free points to distribute.]
"Nice," Leon muttered.
He was now only six levels away from level fifty. Emilia was even closer, only four.
Without wasting time, Leon opened his [Storage Space].
The drops appeared clearly.
[Orc Lord Machete (Epic): +3,000 Attack, +1,700 Strength. Requirement: 5,000 Strength.]
[Sub-Talent Scroll: Mega Spirit Enhancement (A-Level).]
Those were the standard rewards. But beside them was the item he truly wanted.
[Orc Lord Orb (Legendary): Go through the "Orc Trial of Strength" that native orcs usually undergo in the "Lower Domain" and a reward shall be granted based on your performance.]
"Here it is," Leon said with a satisfied grin. "Perfect."
Ghorak had become the city lord because he achieved the best score in this trial.
If Leon surpassed that score, then the reward could be even greater.
There were rumors that the highest possible reward was a sword that massively boosted strength.
That was exactly what he needed before heading toward the [Farlands] or attempting his third assessment.
For now, though, he equipped the [Orc Lord Machete].
Its raw stats still made it his strongest available weapon, and he met the requirement.
Then he turned his attention to the sub talent scroll.
"...One can only hope," he murmured with a faint grin.
He could have used the [Enhancement Frenzy Liquid] to guarantee a higher evolution.
An S Level sub talent would drastically increase his power.
But he decided not to use it yet, even on such a powerful upgrade as there were much more important things in the future to use it on.
He would rely on his luck instead. He pulled the scroll out and poured mana into it.
The parchment glowed brightly.
And then—
Ding!
[Fusion successful.]
Leon’s eyes widened.
"Holy shit... I actually did it."
Ding.
[You have evolved "Mega Strength Enhancement (A-Level)" to "Supreme Strength Enhancement (S-Level)."]
[Supreme Strength Enhancement (S-Level): Permanently increases Strength by 200%.]
Leon stared at the panel in silence.
Two hundred percent. His strength had just tripled compared to his base value.
"Damn..."

She instinctively lifted her scepter and tried to gather mana like she always did.

Nothing happened.
No warmth formed at the tip of her weapon.
It was as if someone had cut an invisible thread that linked her to the world itself.
She tried again, forcing more focus.
Still nothing.
Her mana was there inside her body, but she could not draw it out.
It felt sealed.
Leon watched her reaction from the corner of his eye and immediately understood what was happening.
’This is the complete opposite of the [Trace of Magic Chamber],’ he thought with a faint grin. ’Instead of cutting off strength, this guy is cutting off magic.’
It was a terrifying ability.
Any mage who entered this domain would instantly become useless.
Emilia, who relied heavily on magic for offense, had just lost most of her power in a single moment.
If someone like her were hit by such a restriction during a serious fight, it would immediately turn into a physical battle.
And in a battle of pure strength, Ghorak was among the strongest beings in the entire [Lower Domain].
It was completely unfair.
Ghorak’s grin widened as he flexed his arms.
"Without magic, both of you are defenseless," he declared confidently.
"You might as well accept your deaths."
There was not a hint of doubt in his voice.
No one who had entered his domain had ever survived.
Every invader, every challenger, had fallen the moment their magic disappeared.
And those that didn’t use it to begin with stood no chance either.

"I will allow a one on one battle between the two of us.

Powerful Fireball!
Ice Spikes!
Before Ghorak could even finish his sentence, a massive fireball formed at the tip of Leon’s staff and shot forward at full speed.
"What?"
Ghorak’s eyes widened.
In the decades he had ruled this city, no one had ever been able to use magic inside his [Lord’s Domain].
And yet...
BOOM!
The fireball exploded directly against his chest.
The impact forced him to raise his arm to shield his face as he stumbled backward.
Before he could fully recover, a sharp pillar of ice erupted from the ground behind him.
It did not pierce completely through his body, but it tore into his back hard enough to draw blood.

"You can use magic in my domain?"
